articleTitle: IOT Based Surveillance Camera with GPS Module
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The main intention of this paper is to bring about a surveillance camera to execute the act of surveillance in a particular area. At the present time IoT plays a major role in science and technology. The Internet of Things is taking us to make secure homes, cities and businesses areas by facilitating both the personal and common organizations to remotely and securely monitor the circumstances. The proposed project is to develop a surveillance camera with GPS module. When the signal given to the Raspberry Pi, it sends the corresponding images taken before and after of the signal given to the Raspberry Pi along with the GPS location of the camera to the higher authority through Internet of Things.

articleTitle: A Strategy to Reduce the Importation of Petroleum Oils in Vietnam by Transforming Rice Bran Waste to Vegetable Oil-Based Transformer Liquid Insulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: As vegetable oils was entirely eco-friendly, have an extraordinary dielectric strength, a great flash point, and are more companionable by means of paper insulators comparable with mineral-based insulating oils, they has effectively been used in the areas of insulation for distribution and power transformers. Vegetable oils still suffer from limitations such more viscosity, more pour point, poor oxidation strength, and poor fast mode streamer resistance. As a result, numerous research have been supported out to enhance the qualities of vegetable oils. In order to lay the groundwork for determining the direction of research in vegetable oil-based insulating lubricants in Vietnam, this paper will review the significant investigation findings on the physicochemical behaviour of vegetable lubricants as well as the techniques utilized to increase the efficacy of vegetable oils. And also provides a strategy to reduce the importation of petroleum oils in vietnam by transforming rice bran waste to vegetable oil-based transformer liquid insulation.

articleTitle: An Extensive Critique on Microgrid Control Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Current research in electrical power systems is mainly focus on implementation of smart grid. A microgrid is coming under the category of fundamental unit of smart grid and more than half decade many research implemented on the microgrid. It gives the integration of several distributed energy sources, energy storage elements and multilevel converters topology in the load side to maintain the uninterruptable power supply. Microgrid is commonly functioned in grid connected way during normal conditions and operated in standalone mode during the abnormal conditions. In both the modes the control and operational of the micro grid is same. This article delivers the various functions and control such as matching of voltage, frequency sharing of loads in optimal way, isolation during fault and maintenance conditions is been incorporated in this survey. The real time implementation and control issues, characteristics of microgrid from ideal conditions and normal stage to fault stage, the various applications in residential and commercial buildings is incorporated in this survey. The various technical issues during grid connected and isolated mode is presented in this article. Commonly in four control methodologies is applicable to micro grid operations such as hierarchical control, distributed control, decentralized and centralized control. Every approach is surveyed in brief manner with respect to the operations applications and characteristics. It also indicates various research intervals and future scope. The technical challenges in real time implementation as well as outcomes were shortly examined. Lastly, the study of various methods for microgrids integration, realization and features of smart grid is also surveyed.

articleTitle: Pothole Detection Using YOLOv3 Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: When it comes to moving people and goods around a country, road transports are like the heart and arteries. It is essential that roads need be kept in good shape at all times. Most of the times, potholes on the road surface causes major damages and they must be repaired for maintaining the roads in usable condition. Countries like India, where roads span millions of kilometers and require constant upkeep, it may be difficult to locate potholes. Since this is the case, rapid, accurate, and real-time automated pothole detection is essential. The primary motivation of this proposed work is to explain the pothole prediction models that are created using object detection algorithm called YOLOv3. The YOLOv3 model is trained on a dataset of potholes, and the results are analyzed and compared with variants of YOLO by computing the model's precision, recall, and mAP. When compared to other models, the mAP of this one is improved while the computing cost is reduced significantly.

articleTitle: A Brief Review on Triple Active Bridge DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: An isolated dc-dc Triple active bridge (TAB) converter comprises three active bridges interlined using a three winding high frequency transformer (HFT). The TAB converter has advantages like controllable bidirectional power flow with high efficiency, fixed frequency operation. In the present article a brief review on TAB converter is provided for its different configurations, power flow controls and applications are analysed from research works from past few years. Controls for phase-shift and duty cycle, as well as decoupled power flow management, are also discussed. Conditions for achieving zero voltage switching (ZVS) range are also discussed.

articleTitle: Arduino Based Bluetooth Voice-Controlled Robot Car and Obstacle Detector
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A machine is required when humans would like to work in different environmental conditions, such as toxic material, remote handling of bombs, health conditions, and sewage treatment. The paper aims to build a robot car that monitors the human voice's movement and senses distant objects. The L298N board, HC-05, Arduino Uno microcontroller, ultrasonic sensor, battery, and jumping wires are included in this system. The robot movement and control system is used by the speaker to allow the robot to react to any speaker command that gives any verbal instruction that produces sound frequencies of the human voice. Through the software application, the user of a robotic car will choose the route or path to control the movement of the car. The user can monitor the robot's movements on his own smart device and allow the car to drive in his own way. In this method, a microcontroller with android devices is linked through a bluetooth module to receive desired voice commands. The robot then escapes obstacles and detects distant objects. The android application that is used to convert a voice to a text command and then transmit data to a microcontroller moves the robot via a voice application according to the user's command. After receiving the command, the robot moves in left, right, forward, and backward directions. This device tried to alert workers to the possibility of a terrorist attack in a military camp.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches for Plant Disease Detection: A Comparative Review
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Crop production and growth are crucial factors that have an impact on the agricultural industry, as well as the farmer economically, socially, and in every other manner. Crop failure has several key causes, one of which is plant diseases. Plant diseases can be identified by a variety of signs, including infections, color changes, damaged leaves or stems, abnormal floret, stem, leaflet, bud, or root growth, among others. In addition, leaves exhibit disease indicators such as stains, dryness, premature dropping, etc. The research on using different Deep CNN architectures to detect illnesses of plants from photographs of leaves is reviewed in this paper. It also offers a comparison of models of CNN that were trained on leaf images to recognize and categorize the diseases of plants. Along with the benefits and drawbacks of the various approaches that were described in the prior research, it gives an overview of the performance measures and database used to assess the effectiveness of existing models.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approach for Sign Language Recognition Using DenseNet201 with Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Transfer learning has been utilized to solve many complex real-world problems. Over the last several years, transfer learning had many applications in image and video recognition. To get higher recognition rates, deep and wider architectures of the convolutional neural networks (CNN) have been designed. In this research, we proposed a novel transfer learning-based model using a popular CNN architecture called DenseNet201 for the recognition of Indian Sign Language (ISL) hand gestures. We applied transfer learning to DenseNet201 by freezing some of its layers to retain its knowledge of generalization and fine-tuning the remaining layers for ISL dataset. Pre-trained DenseNet201 was used to extract the features of the gesture images. To classify the ISL gesture, custom layers were added to the pretrained DenseNet201 model. The proposed model helped to achieve higher accuracy of 100%.

articleTitle: Enhanced low dimensional MOSFETs with variation of high K dielectric materials
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This works shows the effect of different dielectric material which are used in gate dielectric material in metal oxide semiconductor field effect transistor (MOSFET). Dielectric material like silicon dioxide <tex>$(\text{SiO}_{2})$</tex>, silicon nitride <tex>$(\text{Si}_{3}\mathrm{N}_{4})$</tex>, hafnium dioxide <tex>$(\text{HfO}_{2})$</tex> are used in this study. Changing the gate dielectric material in MOSFETs can reduce leakage current, hence improving the device's performance metrics. For device designing and simulations computer added design tool Cogenda TCAD is used. After the simulation results are verified using MOSFET reference data, the device structure is designed at 15 nm node technology. Simulation results shows the reduction of OFF current (IoFF), higher on current to off current ratio (ION/IoFF), near ideal subthreshold slope (SS), and enhanced drain induced barrier lowering (DIBL). The proposed circuit shows the improved IOFF of the device by 2 to 3 times, ION by 1.5 times, trans-conductance (gm) by 2 times, output conductance (gd) by 1.65%, and ION/IoFF ratio by <tex>$10^{5}$</tex>. Proposed device is a better replacement to present technology devices in terms of low power and high switching applications.

articleTitle: EV Battery Charging using DAB DC-DC Converter with EPS and DPS modulations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A Dual active bridge (DAB) DC-DC converter comprises two active H-bridges interfaced by a high-frequency transformer (HFT). There are several points of interest in a DAB DC-DC converter as far as the charging application is concerned, such as bidirectional power transfer capabilities, galvanic isolation between the input and output ports, and inherent zero voltage switching (ZVS) features. The DAB DC-DC converter is extensively studied to be designed and suited for various applications, especially EV charging applications. In this work, the DAB DC-DC converter is analysed to operate in the constant current (CC) and constant voltage (CV) operating modes for EV battery charging application. The CC mode of charging is achieved using extended phase shift (EPS) modulation, and the CV mode of operation is implemented using dual phase shift (DPS) modulation techniques. The CV charging mode with DPS modulation technique is achieved using Model Predictive Control (MPC). The simulation of the DAB EV charging system is carried out in MATLAB/Simulink environment, and the observed results are discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Steady-State Analysis of Dual Active Bridge Converter with Single Phase Shift and Dual Phase Shift Modulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In recent times, dual active bridge (DAB) converter topology has gained significant limelight as a power conditioning unit, especially for electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure and DC microgrids. This is mainly due to added advantage offered by DAB with respect to other converters i.e. isolated DC- DC power conversion along with bidirectional power flow capability. The power flow control using a DAB converter for any application is primarily dictated by the understanding of state-of-art of modulation strategies. In this context, this article illustrates the analysis of the converter at steady-state for single-phase shift (SPS) and dual-phase shift (DPS) modulation techniques. The phase displacement/shift patterns and their correlation with different electrical parameters are represented analytically as well as graphically. Open-loop simulation results for both strategies are showcased for a 1 k W, 48 V /300 V system in boost mode of operation. The nature of all the voltage and current waveforms presented are matching with the results available in previous literature. The system can be further investigated for closed-loop operation in microgrid and EV applications having bidirectional power flow capability.

articleTitle: Job Applications Selection and Identification: Study of Resumes with Natural Language Processing and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: For each job ad, the organization received a high number of applicants. Finding the right person's application from various applications is a time-consuming task for any company these days. The categorization of a representative's resume is a time-consuming, labor-intensive, and resource-intensive procedure. Natural language processing and advanced analytics can understand and analyze unstructured written material to extract the required information. The idea is to teach the machine to study text in the same manner that people do. By reviewing applications with natural language processing and machine-learning processing, we may be able to locate people with the abilities and attributes we need more quickly. This study provides a comprehensive assessment of resume selection and identifies the existing work gaps. Different algorithms for machine learning and methodologies for analyzing and interpreting unstructured data have been researched. This study also addresses the research problems and future potential of resume analysis regarding the writing style, word choice, and grammar of unstructured written communication.

articleTitle: Fault Detection in Transmission Line Using ANN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Transmission line plays a very important role in ensuring the continuous supply of electricity. However, there is no such thing as perfect or fault-free. Due to various reasons, may that be exposure to the environment, accident, transmission failure or faults due to mis operation; faults occur in transmission line. This results in sudden increase of current, more heat production in conductors leading to some major accidents. The objective of this paper is to fault detection by introducing Artificial Neural Network (ANN) which is not only fast but also very efficient. Initially, the neural network is feed with six input values, i.e., the values of current and voltages of three phases respectively, and trained using these six inputs. And when the fault occurs, the value of pre-fault and post-fault condition are different, the trained ANN compares these pre-fault and post-fault values to give us the result of its deduction. We have used MATLAB to implement ANN for fault detection.

articleTitle: Modified Boost Converter-Based Speed Control of BLDC Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this article, brushless dc motor speed control using a high gain converter is proposed. The high-gain converter is utilized to regulate the DC link voltage of the six-step inverter. The switching pulses for the six-step inverter are generated using the rotor position sensed by the hall-effect sensor. The high gain converter is controlled using an outer speed loop and an inner current loop to regulate the DC link voltage of the BLDC with a six-step inverter. A comparative study of the Boost converter-fed brushless DC motor and the high-gain converter-fed BLDC motor is carried out. The simulation study shows that the high gain converter with BLDC motor is outperform than the boost converter fed BLDC with six step inverter.

articleTitle: Design And Control of Solar-Battery Fed PMSM Drive For LEVs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper deals with a novel power-drivetrain design of Solar PV-battery powered LEV's driven by Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) along with the motor controller for an automobile application. In this paper mathematical modelling of Electric Vehicle and PMSM motor are done to have the in-depth analysis of performance of vehicle. To harness maximum power from PV array INC MPPT algorithm is used in the model. High efficiency, low cost, extended battery life, smooth torque and improved range, are the main key features considered in this paper. Along with the Solar PV array the LEV is supported with the battery which is connected in shunt to maintain constant voltage across the VSI. To test the robustness of the system the EV motor is operated in three modes i.e acceleration, constant speed and deceleration along with variable solar insolation condition. The functionality of system under dynamic and steady state condition is simulated and verified in MATLAB-Simulink environment.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Two-phase and Three-phase Interleaved Bidirectional DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Bidirectional DC-DC converter topology is typically vital in systems demanding bidirectional power exchange. It is widely incorporated in microgrids, composite energy storage systems, electric vehicles, etc. The architecture is interleaved to enhance the power handling capacity and reduce the ripple current at the input side. Interleaving allows current sharing among different phases, reducing the size of the filter inductor as well as input and output capacitors, thereby enhancing the power density of the converter. This manuscript presents the design and generalized phase shift requirement for an <tex>$N$</tex> - phase non-isolated bidirectional DC-DC converter. The closed-loop simulation of a two-phase and a three-phase non-isolated interleaved bidirectional DC-DC converter is carried out in MATLAB/Simulink considering both boost and buck mode of operation. The results showcase equal current sharing among different phases, thus reducing the input current ripple, minimized dimensions of filter elements and improved thermal distribution of the converter.

articleTitle: An Overview of the Regenerative Braking Technique and Energy Storage Systems in Electric, Hybrid, and Plug-In Hybrid Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper explicates the regenerative braking technique in electric vehicles(EV”s), hybrid electric vehicles(HEV”s), and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles(PHEV”s). In this paper, different efficient Regenerative braking (RB) techniques are discussed and along with this, various hybrid energy storage systems (HESS), the dynamics of vehicle, factors affecting regenerative braking energy, various types of braking force distribution (BFD) and comparison of different battery technologies are also discussed.

articleTitle: Seven-Level Single-Phase Reduced Device Count Multilevel Inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this article, a new single-phase multilevel inverter is presented, one with reduced device count and less voltage stress on the power switches. Seven voltage levels are produced using this design in an asymmetrical voltage source setup. Two input dc sources and six semiconductor switches make up the proposed configuration. Complexity, cost, size, and performance were all improved by reducing power switches, DC voltage, and driving circuits. The elimination of switches, DC voltage, and driving circuits reduced complexity, size, and cost along with increased efficiency. The proposed architecture can be used for applications involving industrial drives as well as <tex>$\mathbf{R}$</tex> and RL loads. Comparisons are made between traditional and proposed topology based on power switch ratio, DC source, and other variables. Utilizing MATLAB/SIMULINK, the proposed asymmetrical multilevel structure is validated.

articleTitle: Deepfake Face Detection Using Deep InceptionNet Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Deepfakes is digital manipulation techniques that use deep learning to produce deepfake (misleading) images and videos. Identifying deepfake images is the most difficult part of finding the original. Due to the increasing reputation of deep fakes, identifying original images and videos is more crucial to detect manipulated videos. This paper studies and experiments with different methods that can be used to detect fake and real images and videos. The Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm named InceptionNet has been used to identify deep fakes. A comparative analysis was performed in this work based on various convolutional Networks. This work uses the dataset from Kaggle with 401 videos of train sample and 3745 images were generated by augmentation process. The results were evaluated with the metrics like accuracy and confusion matrix. The results of the proposed model produces better results in terms of accuracy with 93 % on identifying deep fake images and videos

articleTitle: Design of LCL Filter For Grid Connected Three Phase Three Level Inverter to Meet IEEE 519 Standards
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The design of an LCL filter for a 12 kW three-phase three-level NPC inverter for 400 line-line RMS voltage on-grid connected application is presented in this paper. Harmonics are the main issues for the grid, LCL filter has good capability to compensate harmonics and improve the output. This paper discusses the switching scheme used in this design as well as the LCL filter's bode diagram both with and without damping resistor. The design of this LCL filter has been validated via simulation and it is concluded that resulted output waveforms are meeting the IEEE 519 standards for both current and voltage harmonic distortion limits. Input dc voltages ranging from 600 V to 960 V are applied to the digital setup and it is found that IEEE 519 harmonic distortion limits are meeting for this voltage ranges.

articleTitle: Comparative study of cell balancing techniques for battery module performance optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Imbalance can be caused by anything that can make one's cells so different from others and the reason behind this imbalance are different coulomb efficiency, self-discharge rates, thermal runaway, cell degradation, and incomplete charging of cell pack. These problems may affect overall performance of the pack and hindrance to safety. This paper includes information related to different cell balancing techniques which are further classified into two categories passive and active based on the elements used. The passive technique makes use of a resistor to dissipate extra energy in the form of heat loss while the active one uses inductors, capacitors, and power electronic converters to transfer energy among cells. A comparison is also made on active vs passive in the form of a table as a result it comes to know active cell balancing has an upper edge in various aspects such as fast operating speed, higher efficiency, less balancing time, high safety level, and better performance even though it also has one disadvantage of a complex algorithm, high cost and we cannot transfer energy from lower cell to higher charged cell. As per the applications point of view, this is clear now passive technique can only be used in lower power applications and in portable tools while on the other hand active can be used in higher power applications such as electric vehicles with the battery management system (BMS). This paper includes a theoretical review of various topologies of cell balancing including their advantages and disadvantages which will guide us to select the proper technique or method as per our requirements for energy storage applications.

articleTitle: A Review on Identification of Number Plate and Wrong Way Vehicles Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This review paper provides a detailed survey on vehicle number plate detection and wrong way vehicle detection. This study paper is specially focused at the identification of number plate at railway crossing. When train is at some distance, the barricades are closed for the vehicles on each side of railway crossing. After the closing of barricades, vehicles drivers are supposed to stop their vehicles at each side of the crossing. But drivers, with the intension of going earlier after opening of the barricades, they stand their vehicles at wrong side. Due to this, traffic gets jammed and traffic accidents have increased at rapid rate. So as to avoid this downside, a mechanism can be developed where with the help of camera and the computer vision, vehicles number plates can be identified. System can be developed to have an alarm and to give audio warning to those vehicles who are on wrong lane along with their vehicle number.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Intrusion Detection Scheme to Detect Replay Attacks in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Smart grid involves bi-directional communication among producer and consumer. Further, advanced metering infrastructure in smart grid facilitates transformation of consumer as prosumer through intelligent scheduling. As smart grid incorporates automatic control, communication techniques and information technology, protection against cyber attack is mandate. Though variety of cyber attacks is feasible in smart grid, the proposal addresses the detection mechanism for one of the predominant attacks namely replay attack using machine learning. In replay attack, legitimate node is compromised by the attacker and hence, the node will be sending older messages repeatedly at frequent intervals. In such scenario, the receiving node is busy and is not able to provide service for other legitimate nodes. Further, the older message may cause malfunctioning of control system which is undesirable. To evade this, machine learning based intrusion detection scheme for replay attack detection is proposed. The proposal is implemented in real time using voltage and current sensors, Arduino, Zigbee and Raspberry Pi and the data is monitored through Thing Speak. Further, the data from the Zigbee is collected through XCTU and is fed as input to the pool of machine learning algorithms implemented in MATLAB. The time stamp of the node is used to classify the data either as normal or malicious. Among the algorithms, fine Gaussian Support Vector Machine exhibits better performance metrics when compared with rest of the algorithms which clearly depicts the suitability of the model.

articleTitle: Grid Integrated Electrical Vehicle Bi-Directional Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Grid fed EV system is proposed in this paper. The bi-directional power flow is achieved using buck-boost converter topology such that the EV batteries can be replace as a source of energy storage and as a source during peak hours hence, support the grid profile. For connecting the grid with the overall system, an AC-DC converter with an LCL filter is used. The MATLAB software is used to carry out the overall simulation and modeling work and the results are verified at various conditions.

articleTitle: Real time seatbelt detection using YOLO deep learning model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Monitoring seat belt fastening is an essential safety element in automobiles since it increases protection in the event of an accident. Modern vehicles generally have belt fastness monitoring technology that is easily tricked. A seat belt can also be secured using algorithms that rely on the driver's visual monitoring. Sadly, automakers do not include them in their vehicles because the present algorithms are not very efficient. Most of them employ edge detection strategies such as Hough, Canny, or others. In classifying the driver's seat belt status, this article advises installing a camera within the driver's cabin. To ascertain whether the driver's seatbelt is fastened, use the YOLO neural network-based model. Using the corner detection and the main belt detection, the issue was resolved in two steps. The device can detect whether the seat belt is tight behind the body thanks to these motions. Using tiny-YOLO, the first item was determined to be the major piece of the belt, and the second item to be the corner of the belt. According to the model, which classify belt fastness into these two categories, the belt is neither correctly fastened or it is not fastened. This study presents the comprehensive seatbelt dataset that was assembled from various sources for the detector's training, testing, and validation processes. You Only Look Once (YOLO) will enable accurate seatbelt detection in the process.

articleTitle: On Medical Diagnosis Problem Utilizing Parametric Neutrosophic Discriminant Measure
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In the numerous decision-making processes, the divergence/discriminant measure is one of the most suitable information measures for dealing with the vagueness and impreciseness of the factors affecting the decision-making models. In this current communication, a novel (X, Y)-norm bi-parametric discriminant measure for neutrosophic sets along with some important results have been presented and studied in detail. Also, we have presented the implementation of the proposed discriminant measure for symptomatic detection in the problem of medical diagnosis with a numerical illustration. The results based on the computations have been tabulated and discussed.

articleTitle: Real Time Door Unlocking System using Facial Biometrics based on IoT and Python
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Traditional locking system like key locks are easily duplicated, thus security of the possessions remains to be a threat. With Artificial Intelligence (AI) proving itself to be robust and accurate, implementing the recent advancements in the field of AI, facial recognition is the latest solution to the problem. The paper discusses a unique methodology of training the facial models for door unlocking system using one of the finest algorithms, Local Binary Pattern Histogram (LBPH) integrated with Internet of Things (IoT) technology to create a functional device that can be mounted on doors. The novelty of the research is that a person only has to look into the camera while the required authentication and unlocking mechanism are done by the device. The door unlocks only when the face is authenticated with a preregistered face whereas a mail with the image of the intruder will be sent to the owner if the faces do not match.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of Interaction Based Segmentation Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Image segmentation, from a human's point of view, is the separation of an image into distinct, informative sections that do not overlap. Segmenting an image is a common technique used in image analysis to isolate certain features of interest. When we are working on satellite images we found some problems with existing approaches. These are: The noise and the artifacts in the images are the major problems for segmentation processing especially in satellite images. The inability of the edge detection based algorithms to mask the whole segmented. Object detection and segmentation using automation major issue for low visibility. In this paper, we use CNN based U-net model rapid, robust, and more accurate generalized prediction from high-resolution satellite images. In this paper, we use a convolutional neural network and main deep learning model for semantic segmentation to evaluate the performance factors like precision, recall, FPR, TPR, IOU, MIoU and F score.

articleTitle: Bending Stability Analysis of Flexible Polymer based Temperature Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Temperature sensing on a flexible platform is essential to many healthcare, e-skin, and robotic applications. In this regard, a polymer-based temperature sensor is fabricated where a conductive polymer material i.e. PEDOT:PSS is used as its temperature-sensitive layer on top of a polyethylene terephthalate (PET) substrate. The electrodes are printed with silver ink. To isolate the sensor from environmental noise the sensing layer is encapsulated with epoxy material. After the epoxy encapsulation, the sensitivity increased up to 1.6875 times when compared to without any epoxy encapsulation. Also, the linearity of the response is improved. Without bending the sensor shows a sensitivity of 0.000817 /0C. Further, the fabricated sensor is undergone 150 cycles of both tensile and compressive bending to test its mechanical stability. From the results, it is predicted that some initial bending may stabilize the sensor mechanically to have a less increase in its base resistance.

articleTitle: Design And Development of BLDC Motor Drive For Solar-PV Irrigation System Using MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In recent time energy based on renewable sources is the best long term alternative solution compare to the conventional fossil fuel energy resources, solar photovoltaic array (SPV) based irrigation water pump has gained more popularity. In this paper study has been done with proper utilization of available solar energy which is fed to BLDC motor for irrigation purpose in agricultural field. Between PV array and three phase inverter (VSI) and in between DC-DC boost converter is used for smooth starting operation of BLDC motor by proper control mechanism. To enhance efficiency of solar PV array the IN-C MPPT algorithm method is used. With Pulse width modulation (PWM) method along with DC link bus voltage regulator the speed controlling operation of BLDC motor is performed. High efficiency, reduce dependency on grid and petroleum fuel-based pumping system, are the main key features considered in this paper. The dynamic and steady state performance of given system are simulated under different atmospheric condition using various blocks of MATLAB-Simulink software environment.

articleTitle: On Banking Site Selection Problem Utilizing Novel Picture Fuzzy Discriminant Measure
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The literature on picture fuzzy information comprehensively deals with various applications where the process of decision science plays an important role and helps us with information available which is inaccurate and lacking in some parts. In this manuscript, we present a new parametrized discriminant measures of information for the picture fuzzy environment and suitably applied in solving some kind of conventional decision-making problem of selection of banking site. To be specific, we have utilized these information measure and considered the problem of banking site selection under the technique of minimum discriminant measure in the delta-parametrized form. Also, the superiority and effectiveness of the proposed measures are being numerically illustrated along with the scope for future.

articleTitle: Design Approaches and Performance Analysis of Electric Vehicle using MATLAB/Simulink
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The advancement in technology increases the challenge for the EV manufacturers to increases the range and reliability. For designing, testing and simulation of EVs, the virtual platform plays an efficient role over real designing and testing. This paper presents the design and simulation approaches of Electric Vehicle (EV) for evaluating virtual performance of the vehicle with the given drive cycle. For efficient design, it should be simulated by using a suitable simulator. There are many simulators like MATLAB/SIMULINK, Proteus, GT-Suite and ANSYS SIMPLORER available for the design and simulation of EVs. From most of the available simulators, MATLAB/SIMULINK is mostly used in many industries and by the researchers for design, simulation and performance evaluation of the EVs. In this article, a detailed analysis of the design and simulation are discussed step-by-step approach. The step-by-step approaches will be very much helpful to the designer and researcher to analyze the characteristic of EV under different operating conditions.

articleTitle: Secure-e-Share: Data leakage Detection and Prevention with Secured Cloud Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Data privacy and security has always been a prime concern of any user or an organization, especially when it comes to sharing of confidential files either for different end users or in any organization. Secure-e-Share is one such file-sharing system that creates a secure environment for sharing files of different formats (i.e., zip, Docx, txt, CSV, pdf, etc.). The key protection point of this system is that it encrypts the file and then stores it in the cloud storage which makes the database secure, as only encrypted files are stored. The decryption of a file is done only when the authorized individual accesses it with a unique key provided by the sender. For detection, after every successful transfer, the counter of successful transfer is increased which shows the success rate of the web app, and every case of data leakage is also prevented and detected and recorded creating a threat-free environment.

articleTitle: Cyber Physical Security of a Smart Grid: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: With advancements of smart grids which are, in fact, based on the concept of reliable two-way communication between smart devices, are part of cyber physical systems (CPS). The CPS is a system that is the integration of the physical (Sensors), computational (actuators) and communicational network (s). With the increasing energy demand, the demand for such highly advanced grids had also been increased. And it comes with great responsibilities. These grids are mainly vulnerable to malicious trojans (Black Energy) and spyware which could easily hijack the system. However, many kinds of research have been made to date, but they ‘failed’ to give a broader aspect of security. Mainly security system uses ‘Target location’ based software/methods which are indeed insufficient for the purpose. Comprehensive analysis, classification of attack and real-time health monitoring of the grid and its components have been addressed in this review paper.

articleTitle: Multi band FSS for 5G Signal Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In frequency selective surface (FSS), transmitting signals are modulated in spectrum domain, thus transmission of certain frequency bands is enhanced. A multiband frequency selective surface (FSS) is designed for 5G communications at 2.6 GHz, 3.4 GHz and 4.9 GHz in this paper. Particularly, by introducing four ring structures, the FSS has good angular stability within 45° and for both TE and TM polarizations.

articleTitle: A Review On Strategies Of Electrical Drive Utilization In Solar Powered Airplane
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper studies the arrangements for the electrical drive applications and optimization of vitality streams to preserve the proportionate dissemination of weight and control for the solar-powered airplane. In this paper there are some strategies to demonstrate and optimize the BLDC engine for a solar-powered plane. For getting the ideal arrangements at the given determination all the independent parameters can be determined in one go, main objective is to create the largely extend utilizing the most excellent ideal arrangement counting each component of the solar-powered airplane. This ponders points at planning the solar powered aircraft for communication and working as a satellite. The performance of the model consists of solar MPPT, selecting the best PV cell material, choosing the best dc-dc converter for the MPPT mechanism, and selecting the best electrical drives application to control the propulsion system.

articleTitle: Performance improvement of SEIG based WECS using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper presents the comparison of PI controller-based stand-alone self-excited induction generator-based wind energy conversion systems and ANN(artificial neural network) based SAWECS. A novel SPWM technique is proposed for the generator-side connected converter and a space modulation technique is proposed for load side connected converter. The Generator side converter is to control the real power and reactive power and the load side converter is to control the dc link voltage by the indirect vector control(IVC) method. The proposed SASEIG-based WECS using the different converters are simulated in MATLAB/SIMULINK environment and they are compared at different operating conditions.

articleTitle: On Parametric Picture Fuzzy Information Measure in Pattern Recognition Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Various similarity/distance information measures for the extensions of fuzzy sets have been proposed and utilized in different fields such as data science, clustering techniques, medical diagnosis, econometrics, decision-making, etc. In the present communication, we propose a new kind of parametric distance measure for the picture fuzzy sets and study various set-theoretic binary operations and properties related to the measure along with their mathematical validation. The parametrization feature of this measure provides additional flexibility in processing the information. Further, for a given unknown pattern, based on the proposed parametric picture fuzzy distance measure and the methodology of minimum discriminant information, we classify it into a set of known patterns. A numerical example to show the implementation has also been provided for clarity and better readability.

articleTitle: MR Brain 2D image Tumor and Cyst Classification Approach: an Empirical Analogy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Brain tumors and cysts might prove to be fatal if detection is delayed. Early detection of brain tumors and cysts ensures improved survival rates and thus has become a cause of concern. Multiple models using various algorithms have been used to make the detection accurate at an early stage. A cyst might be an alarming factor and might be the early stage of a brain tumor. This paper focuses on comparing the different methods used to detect brain tumors. The proposed model is trained and tested using six different algorithms. The Kaggle dataset has been used for both training and testing. Two classes from the dataset are used. One of the classes consists of Pituitary Tumors, while the other consists of No tumors. A total of 1222 images have been used for training the proposed model. Images have been resized into 200×200 dimensions for better results. Most of the tumors detected while testing is found to be pituitary tumors. We have used the ensembler classifier having six classes, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Logistics Regression, Random Forest, K Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Decision Tree, and Naive Bayes. Among all the algorithms, Logistic Regression shows the highest accuracy of 99.6%, followed by Random Forests and SVM. Thus, the paper helps us to determine a better algorithm among multiple algorithms for detecting brain tumors and to specify whether it is a pituitary tumor or not.

articleTitle: Intelligent transformation of 6G network by incorporating Expert Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Expert Systems are currently being used in a number of fields, including automated translation, picture and speech recognition, fake news detection and many more. For starters, better standards for network latency, stability, better coverage and user experience are required as network services evolve. Operators and equipment suppliers are attempting to integrate Expert Systems into the network to support network automation and intelligent transformation in an effort to overcome these difficulties. However, in order to maximize the usefulness of an AI engine, significant amounts of data and computational power are needed. As a result, the interaction between Expert Systems is necessary for the future artificial intelligence network in the 5G and 6G era. In order to achieve smart resource management, intelligent service provisioning for 6G networks, this paper suggests an intelligent architecture based on Expert Systems. We identify crucial areas for further research and suggest potential fixes for expert system-based intelligent 6G networks.

articleTitle: Monitoring Health of IoT Equipped 3-Phase Induction Motor using Interactive Dashboard
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Induction motors, one of the most crucial industrial parts, are highly expensive and need regular maintenance. Lack of maintenance knowledge could lead to malfunctions that are unworkable for industries. The motor's continuous operation causes an increase in temperature. It is impossible to manually gauge the temperature of a 3-Phase induction AC motor every single second. If the temperature is higher than the typical or average value, the motor may become flawed, which could affect how well it works. Because of this, it's imperative to constantly monitor the temperature. To resolve this issue the proposed system creates an interactive dashboard, from which defects in temperature variance can be found and examined for preventive maintenance. The motor's maximum, average, and minimum temperatures are displayed on an interactive dashboard. The suggested system's goal is to provide real-time aspect monitoring from any location.

articleTitle: Acoustic Power Distribution Analysis in Different Human Tissues for Bioimplant Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: For the accurate monitoring of tissues for therapeutic, diagnostic, and power transfer applications, reduction of bio-effects, and improvement in the acoustic image quality, it is important to analyse the propagation of acoustic waves in different varieties of human tissues. Therefore, in this work, an acoustic transmitter operating on the frequency of 4.6 kHz at 5 volts excitation voltage and a tissue phantom are simulated and analysed for two different tissues, viz. bone and muscle. Consequently, the power intensity of 1.50 mW/m<sup>2</sup> and 10.44 mW/m<sup>2</sup> is obtained in bone and muscle, respectively. The experiment resulted in the average output voltage of 0.757 V in the palm, 0.189 V in wrist, and 0.013 V near the elbow region in male subject, while 1.26 V in palm, 0.533 V in wrist, and 0.145 V near the elbow region in the female subject. The study depicts that the application of acoustic waves is more efficient in the muscle medium and less efficient in the bone medium.

articleTitle: Smart Contract-Based Land Registration System Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Blockchain is a database that records transactions on many computers. It is a decentralized technology, so all the copies of the blocks are distributed in a network. This solution will remove the problems that exist in the traditional system. The old system has many issues. We still use the conventional registration system, where a broker is between buyer and seller. And he is responsible for all transactions and document verification. The broker will guarantee that the documents are registered with an approved government office, where all the property-related information is kept in a public digital ledger, and the transaction between the two parties takes place. However, anyone with authorization to access these papers may lose, replace or modify them, which risks the protection of property and lands. Blockchain enables us to construct a digital ledger of transactions, events and data secured by a cryptographic algorithm.

articleTitle: An Improved Indexing Technique for Tribal Art Retrieval System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Nowadays the handmade tribal art products attract the people due to their smooth finishing. Currently many platforms are available for them but, they are fetching result with irrelevant list of the product and supports only keyword search. So, there is a need of the tribal art product retrieval system which fetch the results quickly and accurately based on the indexing mechanism. So, the proposed retrieval system has been implemented for fetching the correct result within minimum time from large tribal product dataset. The indexing and retrieved mechanism for image has been improved using deep learning and distributed structure of indexing mechanism. The deep learning technique has been used to fetch the accurate results and distributed indexing mechanism reduces the time of searching the images through the very large tribal art dataset. The proposed system has been analyzed using different parameters. The proposed system gives 82% accuracy of the result based on the input query image.

articleTitle: Music Streaming Using Blockchain - Blockics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Blockics is a music and video player which works on a buy once method (user can buy song or entire album). User can use the platform to access its content s by starting a superfluid stream to the platform and, the accumulated funds from users will be directly transferred to the respective artists. The creator when they are about to go live we will have a feature of crowdfunding, form where they can collect funds in a short period of time. The top donors in crowdfunding will be rewarded with special perks like early release access to next releases, discounts, rare NFTs, etc. Blockchain has several uses that go far beyond virtual currency like bitcoin. The technology is having an impact on a wide range of businesses, changing everything from how contracts are upheld to how efficiently government is managed. In addition to saving businesses time and money, it can enhance transparency and fairness. Smart contracts are similar to regular contracts, but they eliminate the middleman and offer degrees of accountability that is not possible with conventional agreements for all parties involved. Instead, a blockchain is used to enforce the contract's terms in real-time. By doing so, firms can save time and money while ensuring that all parties involved comply. Blockchain-based contracts are becoming more and more common as sectors including government, healthcare, and real estate learn about the benefits..

articleTitle: Security Analysis of Open Source SDN (ODL and ONOS) Controllers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Software-Defined Networking (SDN) is becoming an increasingly relevant networking approach day by day, due to its myriad benefits over Traditional hardwired-based Networks. Still, SDN Controllers are popular for their weak security mechanism. This paper discusses the vulnerability issues in the security of SDN Controllers. The Control layer is the most vulnerable to network attacks in the three-layered SDN architecture. DDoS attacks on the Control layer can cause a Single Point of Failure for the entire SDN network. OpenDaylight (ODL) and Open Networking Operating System (ONOS) are the top two leading open-source SDN Controllers. We found out that ODL and ONOS Controller fail to provide any protection from DDoS attacks. SDN developers have compromised the security aspects of the Controller to improve its performance. In this research article, an attempt is being made to address such security vulnerabilities of SDN with ODL and ONOS Controllers for DDoS attacks.

articleTitle: Mirchi Crop Yield Prediction based on Soil and Environmental Characteristics using modified RNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The economy may be significantly impacted by agriculture. Economic development is impacted by both the direct and indirect GDP (gross domestic product) contributions that agriculture makes. Regular analysis of soil and weather monitoring is essential for ensuring crops develop. In the past, most research on yield prediction based on a variety of variables, including the environment and kind of soil, was done right before planting. However, due to the frequent variation in soil and environmental characteristics, we must regularly understand the soil's features and external factors and take the necessary actions. Inorder to forecast the most effective combinations of soil and environmental parameters, a deep learning-based modified RNN model is employed in this work. The proposed performs better in the forecasting of soil and environmental parameters of Mirchi yield more precisely than the state-of-art models.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Five Level Reduced Switch Count Multilevel Inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper presents the various multilevel inverter(MLI) topologies and compares their conventional and reduced switch topology for a five-level inverter. According to the results of the simulation, Reduced switch topology is constructed with the reduced switch, which causes switching losses to decrease as efficiency increases. The suggested topology reduces THD because it uses a phase disposition technique as the control scheme with a switching frequency of 10 kHz, which was utilised to create a computer-based model of both the standard and reduced switch five level single phase multilevel inverters.

articleTitle: A Review of Metamaterial Absorber and its Absorption Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: As technological developments continue to be made in the realm of communication, there will be an ever-increasing need for the development of materials and techniques that are capable of effectively reducing the adverse effects of electromagnetic (EM) radiation. Metamaterials are artificial materials that reduce the impacts of EM waves radiation on the environment as communication technology advances. In this article, characteristics of EM absorption by metamaterial absorbers (MAs) and its application for various frequencies have been discussed. This paper contains different techniques for designing of absorber unit cell to achieve a 100<sup>%</sup> absorber ratio. Major absorption techniques have been reviewed for achieving 100% absorptivity or unity absorption. The various techniques employing different structures, applications, and parameters have been investigated to improve the absorptivity of metamaterial. This should be valuable for the research and development of MAs.

articleTitle: Online Training and Placement System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This technique offers students a very effective method of placement. With this method, the registration process for students is comparatively simple, and the placement officer may easily get student information. The system has quick access to the students who qualify. The system states that it will inform the kids. It gives us data on the number of students who are placed, which is displayed in the various graphs. The technology aids the college in keeping track of both current and former students. The system provides college with documentation for alumni gatherings. The timetables of all the placement-related activities can be created by the placement officer. Students who meet the requirements are automatically notified by the company. The TnP personnel and students. Since it is accessible around-the-clock, it lessens the communication gap between students and TnP coordinators and TnPs. This solution aids students and TnPs in maintaining their data at a secure portal and makes it possible to use it for additional training and employment activities. By preserving all data on a secure site that can be utilized in the future, it minimizes paper effort. It also offers a single default form that incorporates company counts and information to assist TnPs with future placement operations and retain records of all referral companies.

articleTitle: Semi-automatic Analysis of cells in honeybee comb images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Our environment depends on honeybees. In the face of global honey bee decline, colony strength assessment can help apiary management and provide valuable research data. Counting honey, brood, pollen, larvae, and bee cells manually and classifying them based on visual judgement and estimation is time-consuming, error-prone, and requires a qualified inspector. Digital image processing and AI developed automated and semi-automatic solutions to make this arduous job easier. Prior to classification of cells, it is necessary to detect all the cells correctly. The objective of this study is to provide an efficient method to identify all the uncapped cells in honey comb images. The paper is organized with the discussion of problem's background and evaluation first. Further, we give a thorough review of the existing work and explore a possible application. After that, we discussed the methodology adopted in literature. Overall, our investigation is thorough and extensive.

articleTitle: An Efficient Technique for Improving Trust and Privacy in Blockchain as a Service (BaaS)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Cloud computing is a developing technology used for providing various services such as PaaS, IaaS and SaaS for various applications based on the pay as per usage. The foundation of trust is the assurance and confidence that information, people, entities, data, or processes will deliver the desired outcome with a particular level of assurance. Many times, users even do not have knowledge about processing their personal information over the clouds. In cloud computing, centralized architecture is used for trust modeling, which causes various trust and privacy issues. The trust model is subject to a number of limitations, including single point failure, overload, vulnerability to malicious assaults, particularly harmful recommendations, and lack of accessibility and untraceability of trust proof. There are numerous initiatives underway to increase confidence between cloud users and CSPs. The privacy issues including data leakage and compromising data integrity in the cloud environment. The blockchain technology can provide the solution for the above issues. The Blockchain technology has various advantages as it is decentralized in nature, immutable ledgers, providing full transparency, Instant traceability, data encrypted end-to-end. In the proposed system hybrid consensus algorithms are created to overcome problems of the existing blockchain consensus algorithm. By using blockchain technology creates a Blockchain as a Service (BaaS) in the cloud environment to improve the trust and privacy of users.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Multilevel and 2-level Inverters for High Voltage E-drive Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper presents a detailed literature study on the advantages of using higher voltages and the usage of multilevel inverters in electric vehicles. Use of higher voltages with a multilevel inverter improves the overall performance of E-drive application. Lower charging time, better efficiency, higher power density, better THD and waveform quality, inherent fault tolerance and lower frequency of operation are the foremost advantages of using high voltage multilevel inverters in electric vehicles. A detailed parametric study using MATLAB simulation tool is performed and simulation results are presented in this paper. Comparison of multilevel inverters and 2-level inverters in terms of many basic parameters like losses and efficiency, cost, total harmonic distortion, switching frequency, reliability and fault tolerance are discussed in this paper. Inverter losses modelling and simulation results are also discussed.

articleTitle: A Review On College Enquiry Chatbot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: As we all know before the invention of the Chatbot it was difficult to visit colleges to gather information as it was consuming time but after the invention, it became very easy to gather information sitting in one place. The first chatbot was invented by Joseph Weizenbaum in 1966 and named ELIZA. It worked when the user passed the words into the computer and paired them into a list of possible responses. As we introduce about college inquiry chatbot, the college inquiry chatbot is worked for any users like students, teachers, parents, and any other outsider who need basic information about the college.

articleTitle: Optical Performance Analysis of GaAs Thin Film Solar Cells with different Anti-Reflection Coatings
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This article aims to increase light absorption and improve efficiency by using antireflection coatings on solar cells. Optical losses owing to the reflection of the incident photons from the solar cell (SC) surface are one of the most significant factors affecting the efficiency of the SCs. In this work, two cases were considered: GaAs planar structure without antireflection coating (ARC) and the other with four different ARCs in the form of ZnO, PEDOT: PSS, Ta<inf>2</inf>O<inf>5</inf>, and MoO<inf>3</inf>. Simulation of the structures is done using the Wave Optics Module of COMSOL Multiphysics. The optical characteristics of the coated and uncoated ultrathin solar cells are analysed from wavelength 300 to 870 nm. The optical properties, such as absorptance (A(λ)), optical JSC, electric field (E-field), and photogeneration rates (Gopt) are computed to understand the optical trapping effects of the investigated structures. For the optimized thickness of 90 nm for ZnO and PEDOT: PSS ARC over GaAs ultrathin SC, the reflection losses are 68 % and 60.8 %, respectively lower than the planar ultrathin structure. Out of all the investigated structures, ZnO-coated GaAs ultrathin SC recorded highest optical JSC of 26.89 mA/cm<sup>2</sup> and 31.6% higher absorption as compared to planar GaAs structure.

articleTitle: Novel Deep Neural Network for Suspicious Activity Detection and Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Implementing preventive measures against gunshots and terrorist attacks in public areas with heavy foot traffic is crucial. Although security cameras are already commonplace, real-time reaction and 24/7 monitoring needed for automated detection techniques. As opposed to a weapon alone, a weapon in the hands of a human is thought to pose a larger threat. This paper has introduced a novel algorithm for multiple gun detection with an innovative deep learning neural network (DNN) model. The parameter for human suspicious activity in this paper is a person with a weapon(gun) and a person wearing a helmet with a weapon(gun). The temporal complexity of the Proposed System Architecture (PSA) on various hardware platforms is also explored. The algorithm gives 99% accuracy as compared with other existing methods.

articleTitle: Energy Meter and Power Theft Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Power theft is typically accomplished through one of two methods: bypassing, hooking and removing the casing. To search it, a system is proposed in which household current is distributed directly from the electric pole to the distribution box and then to individual houses. The Users' information is kept in the database. which is thinkspeak aap during the installation of the electric meter Wi-Fi module, If there is a marginal difference between current readings from the electric meter and distributor box and opening the casing, it detect the difference between primary and secondary current then the theft is detected. This paper discusses energy meters and power theft detection system.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Intelligent Control for DSCC Based Modular STATCOM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this research, a modular multilevel converter-based M-STATCOM is investigated using an Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) controller tuned with Social Sky Driver (SSD) for the enrichment of power quality and reactive power requirements during uncertainties. The suggested ANFIS controller has the benefits of a fuzzy system with the SSD algorithm's short response time and adaptability. The fuzzy controller of the STATCOM created a database that was used to train the ANFIS structures. It has been found that the proposed hybrid controller significantly enhances the system's voltage profile during severe disruptions. The findings demonstrate the proposed STATCOM-based ANFIS controller's resistance to problem localization and changes in operating circumstances. The findings demonstrate the proposed STATCOM-based ANFIS controller's robustness to faults and changes in operating circumstances. Additionally, the efficacy and reliability of the suggested approach for STATCOM are examined by comparing the simulation results with those from the standard STATCOM under three lines to ground fault.

articleTitle: Application of linear optimization technique to design a fixed coefficient multiplierless sample rate conversion filter for multiple-of-three decimation factor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Multirate sampling is used to increase or decrease the original sampling rate of signal. Decimation decreases the original sampling rate while interpolation increases it. Simplest of decimation filter is comb filter. In this paper a Cascaded Integrator Comb sample rate conversion filter for multiple-of - three decimation factor is designed. The linear programming optimization technique is used to flatten passband of filter and expanded cosine filter is used to increase the stopband attenuation in third folding band. The results indicate that the proposed filter shows less passband droop with increase in stopband attenuation. The proposed design has passband droop <tex>$\leq 0.009\ \text{dB}$</tex> with alias rejection <tex>$\leq-156\text{dB}$</tex> in first folding band. The passband droop has improved by 99% approximately.

articleTitle: A Survey of A-Star Algorithm Family for Motion Planning of Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: For autonomous vehicles, one of the prime tasks to be able to function without any human assistance is the task of motion planning. Motion planning involves planning a safe, collision-free and a computationally feasible path to avoid the obstacles in their way and precisely reach the desired location in as less time as possible. The continual efforts in developing new and improving existing path planning algorithms has led to significant advances in improving the autonomy of the autonomous vehicles. One of the most popular algorithms used in path planning is the A * search algorithm, whose several variations have been formulated over the years. This gives a rise to the need of a comprehensive survey of such variations of the algorithm. This paper presents a review of various variations of the A * algorithm along with a brief review of the classical A * algorithm.

articleTitle: Data Driven UX/UI design for reproductive health tracker
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Human-computer interaction (HCI) design seeks to improve the naturalness of user-system interaction. User experience (UX) is important because it tries to meet the needs of users. It is designed to provide a positive experience that connects users to the product or brand. In addition, a meaningful user experience allows us to define the customer journey on the product that best ensures the success of the business. This project focuses on its UX/UI development for an application that is a useful platform for reproductive health monitoring. We used data analysis techniques to guide UX design decisions. A detailed survey was created to help gather data on application preferences and expectations from a large number of potential users. We analyzed collected data sets, using data analysis algorithms to make decisions at different stages of the design process. User personas are often qualitatively developed by UX researchers. Data-driven personas, or personas created using unsupervised methods, can reveal underlying trends and patterns within groups of users. As a result, we are better able to recognize the many user personas that this application is aiming for. The choice of color palette, typography, and other decisions in the design process was made by analyzing user data collected through extensive research. By combining these two technologies, we can create a data-driven user experience.

articleTitle: Comparing HTTP And COAP For IoT Low-power and Lossy Networks Using The Cooja Simulator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The Internet of Things is made up of linked physical objects like cars, appliances, and other things that transmit data (IoT), These products, which contain electronics, software, sensors, and actuators, are efficient with regard to resources. But many IoT devices are too small to create a secure connection. This implied that action needed to be taken right now. As a result, The Internet Engineering Task Force developed the Constrained Application Protocol (CoAP). The Http protocol and CoAP are contrasted in this article..

articleTitle: Design an IoT Based Highway Toll Plaza System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The main concept of paper is to design a toll collection model using RFID based on Internet of things (IOT) concept. Proposed work is mainly based on sensors and RFID which are connected to Arduino. Therefore, the amount deducted from the RFID tag can be found through IOT server using node MCU. The use of RFID modules that mechanically collects the toll from shifting automobiles once they cross the toll plaza. Proposed system of project addresses the problems comes at toll plaza. The development of main roads increases the number of toll plazas. There are long queues at this number and further delays due to the time it takes to pay cash and return change. We view reports on the total time that a particular vehicle spends in traffic, assessing the overall fuel consumption and human intervention in the process. We develop an IoT-based toll plaza management system that can use RFID to pay fares. The work on this system, based on an automated counting system, can be fully manage using the concept of Internet of Things and based on RFID technology and QR / barcode using Arduino. Further, the idea of automating the entire payment process with IoT technology is to provide an optimal solution.

articleTitle: Decentralized File Sharing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The popularity of peer-to-peer architecture has expanded during some recent years. This is due to the fact in comparison to conventional systems, Peer-to-peer systems offer better performance, scalability, availability, security, and anonymity. Most applications and services rely on central authorities for transfer of files. This introduces a single point of failure to the system. The relevant authority should be depended on to have facts saved via way of means of the utility to be had at any given time. More importantly, the privacy of the consumer relies upon the provider company's functionality to hold the facts safe. A decentralized system could be the technique to remove the dependency on a central authority. Moreover, because of the speedy boom of cellular tool utilization, the provision of decentralization should now no longer be confined best to desktop computers. This survey research examines the architecture of such systems using various peer-to-peer architectures. In this work, we aim at studying a decentralized file-sharing system to make it more secure than in previous works. This can be achieved by implementing a P2P protocol with authentication. We validate the outcomes via way of means of deploying and measuring the accuracy and security of file transfer in multiple devices.

articleTitle: A Review on Dam Water Level Alerting System Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The goal we outline in this article is the application system with Internet of Things (lOT) integration to secure the public's safety regarding the early warning of flood events caused by a rise in water levels in the dams and reservoirs. To accomplish the goal, a Software-as-a-Service is upheld, incorporating information about the area and data from periodic water level monitoring using wireless technologies and Global System for Mobile Communication (GSM). As a result, the public is automatically informed of the earlier stages of the water level rise.

articleTitle: ANN based Solar MPPT for BLDC Motor load using Bidirectional Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Solar is a widely used renewable source of energy and therefore gaining profit from them efficiently and storing them for later use is crucial. Solar panels are connected to a boost converter to enhance the voltage according to the requirement. For improving the system performance, an artificial neural network (ANN) is used for maximum power point tracking (MPPT).
