As the earth has varying temperatures, so it is crucial to reserve energy in batteries to use it up to the fullest, so to meet such a purpose, a bidirectional converter is used which stores energy if the power exceeds the required value and delivers energy whenever is required. As conventional vehicle usage leads to an increase in pollution, so Indian government has planned to be a 100<sup>%</sup> electric vehicle nation by 2030, so electric vehicles (EVs) are highly used. In EVs, mainly brushless DC (BLDC) motors are connected because they are advantageous as compared to others. The MATLAB results are also shown to validate the system.

articleTitle: A Novel Miniaturized Triple-Band Monopole Antenna for 2.4/5.2 GHz WLAN and 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A novel miniaturized triple-band monopole antenna is introduced in this work for Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN) and Sub-6 GHz 5G applications. It covers 2.4/5.2 GHz bands of WLAN and NR-77 (3.3 - 4.2 GHz) and NR-78 (3.3 - 3.8 GHz) standards of 5G communication. The triple-band characteristics of the proposed antenna are due to i) an integrated meander slot on the patch, ii) a rectangular patch, and iii) an integrated stepped slot on the ground plane. The antenna's meander and stepped slots are open-ended quarter wavelength long operating at lower and higher frequency bands of WLAN. The conventional rectangular patch is responsible for the radiation across the 5G spectrum. The optimized antenna through parametric analysis is operating at 2.44, 3.5, and 5.3 GHz with a compact footprint of 0.03 <tex>$\boldsymbol{\lambda}_{\mathbf{0}}^{\mathbf{2}}$</tex>. It provides reasonably good return loss characteristics of -18, -17, and -32 dB at the targeted resonant frequencies. It reports a decent -10 dB return loss bandwidth of 3.3 % (2.4 2.48 GHz), 24.6% (3.3 - 4.2 GHz), and 9.5% (5.0 -5.5 GHz). It exhibits good radiation characteristics in Co-pol to Cross-pol level, peak gains of 1.23, 2.14, and 2.83 dBi, and radiation efficacies of 86, 96, and 89% in the lower, middle, and higher operating bands. The presented triple-band antenna's excellent performance with the compact feature is suitable for portable wireless devices to provide simultaneous wireless connectivity for the targeted applications.

articleTitle: HoneyTrack: An improved honeypot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: With the tremendous growth of cyber-attacks, the loss of private or sensitive data has risen to a peak. Honeypots are one of the most concerned topics in the field of cyber security currently. HoneyTrack is a honeypot that uses various technologies like Docker, Shell Scripts, Python, Elastic Search, Kibana, and Filebeats which protect an organization's database as well it backtracks the hacker when it intrudes the target network. Information about the attacker will be gathered by the bot in the honeypot which will help us reach the roots of the attacker. The target networks could be varied and cause a lot of damage when sensitive data will be lost/stolen. However, this honeypot is like a traditional honeypot but quite updated with new-generation technology and their needs related to cyber-security.

articleTitle: Simulation and Performance Analysis of a Fuel Cell Hybrid Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The ever-increasing global energy demand, combined with the scarcity of fossil fuels, air pollution, and greenhouse gas emissions, has pushed the globe towards the adoption of electric vehicles. The scarcity of public charging stations is a key impediment to broad adoption of electric vehicle infrastructure for charging. Hydrogen is a form of energy that can be stored and it has the power to deliver massive volumes of energy. Fuel Cells use hydrogen as their main fuel. This research paper focuses on Fuel Cell Hybrid Electric Vehicle (FCHEV), that is the combination of any energy storing element like an ultra-capacitor or battery with fuel cell to fulfill the power demand which is essential for the electric motor and the device attached to it. Here, Ultracapacitor is used along with FCEV to store energy. A Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) is used here for transmission purpose. This article deals with designing and analysing the performance of the FCHEV model developed in MATLAB Simulink.

articleTitle: AI Based Segmentation Technique to Identify Abnormality in MRI Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Medical image processing is the most demanding and upcoming fields today. This paper proposes an efficient strategy for segmentation to detect abnormalities in patient's brain MRI images. To show the differences in tumor of brain MRI and its assimilation with input images a high pass filter is used. In this work an AI based algorithm is proposed named as Convolutional Wavelet Network (CWN). For effective segmentation of the brain MRI, CWN and softmax classification is done for effective segmentation. This paper concludes with experimental results which indicate that the technique which is proposed gives a better accuracy (99.44%) than the previous models, high DSC values which indicates that the model can facilitate abnormality identification in brain MRIs.

articleTitle: Sarcasm Detection Analysis – Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Sarcasm is a unique class of figurative language, that is in particular utilized in on-line social media. Such messages are used for sarcastic feedback the usage of contemptuous, taunt, and mock-associated phrases or phrases. Normally, the term 'rule-primarily based totally method is implemented to structures concerning human-crafted or curated rule sets. There are many algorithms for figuring out whether or not a sentence is sarcastic or now no longer. This paper complies with the Rule-primarily based totally method this is evolved to address the trouble of sarcasm detection and additionally describes numerous datasets. However we can in particular cognizance on Random Forest, Decision Tree, Support Vector Machine. In our project we are going to compare the accuracies from the model used and find the most accurate model giving high accuracy.

articleTitle: A PV-Powered Microcontroller-Based Agricultural Robot Utilizing GSM Technology for Crop Harvesting and Plant Watering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A solar-powered, intelligent grass cutter and pesticide application system that uses microcontrollers, sonar sensors, solar panels, and GSM technology is being proposed as a solution to the issue of high labor costs in the agricultural sector of Bangladesh. This is done in order to achieve exquisite cost management. The initial objective is to design a system that, through utilizing a robot controlled by a micro controller, will make the laborious work of our farmers and entrepreneurs more feasible. This machine can trim the grass, apply pesticides, and simultaneously provide the plant with water. Solar panels are used to extract power from the sun to charge the device. At long last, GSM technology has been integrated, turning this device into one that can be remotely controlled using a straightforward SMS protocol.

articleTitle: Smart Car Parking System using Arduino
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper deals with a simple smart vehicles parking system by using basic components like Arduino Atmega328p (micro controller), IR Sensors, Servo Motor, LCD etc. Parking, offered in malls, shopping areas, etc., are provided with help of a person which is very time consuming. Because of this, we created a straightforward vehicle parking system that uses IR sensors installed at parking spaces to detect the presence of parked vehicles, an LCD display board that shows the number of vacant and occupied parking spaces, and an LCD display board that shows the number of parking spaces currently available. Therefore, the research methodology work solution creates and implements an experimental setup that will regulate traffic in parking areas while also informing drivers about free spots. The main function of the servomotor is to permit and prohibited vehicles in and out of indoor spaces by opening and turning off the entry or exit barrier according to the data obtained from the IR sensors which are present on the entry gate, exit gate, parking spots.

articleTitle: Auto Detection of Personal Protective Equipment on Human
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In our Daily life cycle, we come across many situations where being cautious and safe is the priority. Often these situations occur at a particular and Defined place, like Hospitals, Airports, Food Sector, etc. Not only for a Personal view but this can affect a group of people too. The Fastest way to spread of Bad Bacteria and Viruses is Airborne i.e. by contact with the surrounding air. This includes a significant aspect of the spread of the virus through CO2 released by Human beings, Sneeze, coughing, etc. At those times, wearing a Mask comes in it for the best precaution. When it comes for Food preparation and packaging, head caps or surgical caps are one of the identified asset. Wearing a surgical cap prevents hairs and bacteria in it to mix with the food. There are many Algorithms and methodologies to Provide Object Detection but this paper has the Efficient working Approach. Our Model will detect Human beings at the Entrance of Respective Areas where Supervision and Care should be taken without Fail. The Screen will show as well as a Voice will Convey whether the Person is being cautious and wearing a Mask and cap before entering a Cautious place or not.

articleTitle: Building Intelligent Embodied AI Agents for Asking Clarifying Questions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Interactive embodied agents are intelligent agents present inside some virtual environment and interact with humans to do tasks we want them to simulate. The communication takes place in some verbal or non-verbal form. This kind of communication gives a better and richer experience and more possibility for users to be satisfied with the carried-out task. An intelligent agent analyzes the environment it is in and performs tasks with all its knowledge based on the interaction. The task is carried out in the game environment where the Agent resides. There are some challenges to an agent that it needs to address, as well as to understand the instruction given to it. The next challenge is asking for clarification if the instruction given is unclear. In this research paper, we have discussed the problems mentioned above using the dataset provided by the NeurIPS 2022 IGLU Challenge which is a labeled dataset. We have discussed the various approaches for the problem mentioned.

articleTitle: Agriculture Advisory Using ML in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)

articleTitle: Comparison of different levels of cascaded H bridge multilevel inverter using PSPWM technique for EV applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This study compares several levels of cascaded H-Bridge multilevel inverters using the PSPWM techniques for applications in electric vehicles (EV) and hybrid electric vehicles (HEV). A DC-DC boost converter is used by the current power inverter systems for HEVs to increase the battery voltage for a typical three-phase inverter. The HEV drive inverters used nowadays have a poor power density. Due to its high power applications and low harmonic distortion, the multilevel inverter is frequently employed in the fields of energy distribution, electric vehicles, and control systems. This paper examines the performance of cascaded H-Bridge multilevel inverters with five, eleven, twenty-one, and forty-one levels, as well as the overall harmonic distortion, waveform pattern, output voltage, number of switches, input DC voltage and switching spectrum using MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Apply machine learning and image processing to detect plant diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: There are a number of issues that farmers are currently facing, including those related to climate change and the production of crops. One problem is that farmers may not be aware of diseases that can affect their plants, leading to poor growth. The Internet of Things (IoT) can help address this issue by connecting physical objects, such as sensors and actuators, to the internet. This allows for better collaboration and monitoring of tasks, as well as improved visibility into the status and growth of plants. IoT devices can be placed on farm fields to detect diseases in plants and alert farmers to any issues. These devices can also provide information about the climate and offer suggestions for addressing problems. A wireless sensor network (WSN) can be used to monitor plants for diseases and gather data about the environment. An automatic learning decision support system can be implemented to manage the disease detection process and provide reliable results. This innovative approach can help farmers make informed decisions about their crops and improve the overall efficiency of their operations This paper highlights the importance of using technology in agriculture to improve efficiency and outcomes. By implementing IoT solutions, farmers can better anticipate and prepare for changes in the climate and monitor the health and growth of their crops. This allows for more informed decision making and can ultimately lead to increased productivity and success in the field.

articleTitle: Facial Image Super-Resolution with CNN, “A Review”
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This survey paper discusses the various applications of super-resolution techniques with their various network designs using deep convolution neural networks. Recent research in state-of-the-art methods has been compared with their performance evaluation matrix, and the image's loss functions have also been discussed to improve image performance. Facial-based work is becoming more popular in super-resolution due to its more practical application. A brief study is described to improve the network's complexity, which helps new researchers gather information for their network designs, different filter sizes, CNN architecture, and standard data sets. Regardless of the advancement as of late, we distinguish a few inadequacies of existing systems and give future research direction towards the arrangement of these open issues.

articleTitle: Third Eye – A Smart Wearable Glass With Deep Learning Technology Powered With Artificial Intelligence for Visually Impaired People
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Our work is intended as a “THIRD EYE” to empower visually impaired persons with their difficulties. It is an innovative glass with AI Assistant, Image Detector (with YOLO), Sensor, and a few add-on capabilities. To alleviate the difficulty of traveling for the visually impaired, this project proposes an intelligent guiding device in the form of eyewear that would provide them with efficient and safe guidance. Understands the user's vocal commands and provides the necessary information through auditory feedback over micro speakers. As a result, it is a user-friendly technology that assists visually impaired people in traveling safely.

articleTitle: Determination of Battery Life Using State of Health Data and Linear Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The lifespan of a battery is a significant factor in the performance and reliability of electronic devices. The state of health (SoH) of a battery is a measure of its ability to store and deliver energy, and it can be used to predict how much longer the battery will last. This study proposes a machine learning method for determining the remaining life of a lead-acid battery based on its SoH using the Coulomb counting method. The charging and discharging parameters were recorded for several cycles, and this data was used to train a machine-learning model. The model was then tested using a different set of data, and the results showed that it was able to accurately predict the remaining life of the batteries based on their SoH. This approach has the potential to be used in a variety of applications, such as managing batteries in electric vehicles and renewable energy systems.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a Voice Controlled chessboard using an X-Y Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper describes the automated chess game using the basic functionality of positing system attached with logic written in the microcontroller board. There are around eight hundred million chess players in the world. This infers that Chess is a game enjoyed by all categories of people. The Categories also include elderly people and differently abled people. These individuals have the intelligence to play chess however their ineptitude to move the coin becomes a struggle. They need support to play this game. The specialized design of a chessboard is implemented to move the coins in an automated environment in order to overcome this struggle. The Design includes a hardware structure embedded with the directions documented in the microcontroller software. A positioning system attached to a magnet moves underneath the chessboard to keep the magnetic coin in the desired position. This positioning system works as per the directions written in the microcontroller software. The inputs for the microcontroller are given through voice commands that are given by the player. This Prototype has optimized the space according to the size of the coins and moves exactly the way a real human moves. The objective of this automated chessboard design is to be able to play using voice-controlled commands. In this design, the chess game will be played by two players with a microphone fitted for both. Once the coins are placed as per their positions, thegame will become hands-free. This will allow the players to enjoy the game without depending on their arms.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of Income Prediction Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: One of the main problems with determining income for employees is that there is no single formula that can be applied to all employees. Each employee's income is based on a variety of factors such as job position, experience, and special skills. Another problem is that the cost of living in different parts of the country can vary significantly, making it difficult to accurately assign a salary to different employees. The third issue is that there are variations in the types of benefits and perks that employers offer, which can make it difficult to accurately compare total compensation between different positions. Finally, there are often external factors that can affect the income of employees, such as the economic conditions of the area they are located in or the cost of health insurance. It is important to know what will be the income of employees to ensure that they are paid fair wages for their work and to ensure that total compensation is competitive with the market. Knowing the income of employees is also important to ensure that the employer can budget for salaries, benefits, and other costs associated with hiring and employing staff. To overcome the problems, we have made a model using the different models of LSTM. This paper presents a comparative study of various deep learning techniques for income prediction. Specifically, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Stacked LSTM, Bidirectional LSTM, and Convolutional Long Short-Term Memory (Conv-LSTM) architectures are used to predict income. Simulations are processed on the Socio-Economic dataset having twenty-six years of monthly income data. This study provides insights into the effectiveness of deep learning techniques for predicting income.

articleTitle: Design of metasurface radome with large angle stability in Ku-band
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Ku-band antennas are playing an increasingly important role in satellite communication systems, and microwave radomes exhibiting bandpass behavior are highly desirable for antenna systems. In this paper, we propose a double-layer metasurface radome which can show high transmission characteristics at large angular incidence in Ku-band, allowing the antenna to maintain its good performance. The joint simulation results of this radome and antenna show that such metasurface exhibits insertion loss < 1dB within <tex>$\pm 50^{\circ}$</tex> oblique angle incidence in the <tex>$16\sim 17$</tex> GHz.

articleTitle: Raisin Grain Classification Using Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This study presents machine learning models developed to classify two different species of raisins grown in Turkey. This study uses the Raisin Dataset from the University of California Irvine Machine Learning Repository. The Raisin Dataset contains 7 morphological features of 900 raisin grains. This study presents an efficient way of pre-processing the raisin data using Feature Selection with Random Forest to determine the most important features. By only using one feature that was found to be the most important, the best model (Multi-Layer Perceptron) yields an accuracy of 94.07%, outperforming previous models used to classify raisin grains with this dataset.

articleTitle: Novel Four-Stage Comparator with High Speed and Low Kickback Noise
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The implementation of CMOS four-stage comparator with improved speed, kickback noise and resolution is the subject of this paper. After performing functional verification, it is observed that cascading of pre-amplifiers can achieve a faster speed, the proposed comparator offers higher speed of operation, as compared to typical dynamic comparators referred in this paper. Furthermore, the noise cancelling mechanism of a complementary input pair is used at the preamplifier stage in the proposed four-stage comparator, which is identical to that of the referred three-stage comparator. The kickback noise is considerably reduced compared to that in the three stage comparator by introducing a new method for kickback noise cancellation which will stabilize the operating point. The proposed comparator also offers a better resolution compared to the state-of-the-art work, during the regeneration stage, it significantly helps to boost the speed even more. Simulated results show that the proposed four-stage comparator reduces the delay and kickback noise by 45.53% and 32.35% respectively as compared to Zhuang's Comparator. All simulations are run on the same technology node TSMC 180nm for fair comparison with the existing designs. These advantages are obtained at the cost of increased energy per comparison and input referred noise marginally.

articleTitle: Sub-10-nm Tunnel Field-Effect Transistor with Schottky Drain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: An SD-TFET, which is a tunnel field effect transistor with Schottky drain, is proposed in this paper for sub-10-nm applications. On-off switching characteristics were examined by examining some of the critical device parameters, including the metal work-function in a Schottky drain. When designing SD- TFETs for low-power integrated circuits, a moderate Schottky drain work-function is preferred.

articleTitle: Priority Based Task Scheduling in Cloud Integrated WOBAN Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Access network infrastructures are being heavily tested by the advent of new multimedia services. Wireless-optical broadband access network (WOBAN) is being developed to address such demands. In a WOBAN, service requests migrate from the wireless front end to the optical backend to reach distant cloud servers, creating wireless network bottlenecks that could degrade performance. Thus, Cloud Integrated WOBAN (CIW) is a popular method for combining cloudlets with WOBAN to provide resource-intensive and delay-sensitive applications. Data packets go through a number of intermediary nodes in CIW from the source node to a wireless frontend cloudlet. However, it is a problem to figure out how to schedule these packets throughout the many cloudlets. The proposed work examines the priority-based scheduling method with the packet deadline constraint. The outcome examines a parametric evaluation of the algorithm in terms of the packet drop for the highest priority applications.

articleTitle: Car Hiring System using Web Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Traveling is one of the things people do to lessen their strain or stress. By utilising the most recent technologies, we were able to simplify the process of renting cars in our project. When a person does not drive their own car or does not have one in any way, renting a car makes it more practical for them to get around. However, in the modern world, there are numerous risks, such as added costs, driver cancellation after learning the cost, or extremely long journeys. Therefore, a character who wants transportation must identify an employer for an automotive apartment and execute a contract. This tactic also promotes customer retention while also making it easier for businesses to hire and retain employees. Using the XAMPP database, this project has improved the assistance provided by the vehicle rental companies for the clients regarding the booking status and the availability of the held vehicle. This project has used insight into using technology to construct and integrate the online framework with SMS innovation. As a result, the framework offers a practical method of observing. Additionally, this framework makes it simple to use PHP to obtain vehicle information, reserve a vehicle, and immediately lease a vehicle.

articleTitle: A Review on Graphene Transistors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The silicon complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) technology is the leading electronic industry. Today, silicon CMOS technology has hit its basic limits (physical and geometrical), which for future technical nodes is the key roadblock. The problem with silicon is its poor stability below 10 nm, since it decomposes, and migrates unpredictably. Graphene field-effect transistors (FETs) are promising devices for the next generation of electronic and photonic devices. Graphene FETs have many advantages over traditional silicon-based transistors, including higher electron mobility, higher on/off ratio, and the potential for high-speed operation. In addition, graphene FETs have been demonstrated to have excellent device stability, low-power operation, and low-cost fabrication. This review discusses the current state of graphene FET technology, including device physics, fabrication techniques, and device performance. The potential of graphene FETs in applications such as high-speed computing, and energy-efficient electronics is also discussed.

articleTitle: The Sensitivity Analysis of Metasurface-based Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a sensitive sensor for detecting an ultra-wide range of different kinds of materials that represented by the dielectric permittivity. Based on the boundary conditions of the electromagnetic field and the propagation properties of planar electromagnetic waves in a three-layer flat media, we analyze the sensitivity of the metasurface structure loaded at the media interface by mathematical derivations and HFSS simulations. In the metasurface-based sensor, the parallel resonance surface structure has the ability to tune <tex>$f_{0}$</tex>. Compared with the sensing structure without metasurface design, the metasurface case can enhance the sensitivity in detecting the wide range of material with permittivity <tex>$10\sim 100$</tex>. We compare the theoretical calculations with the full-wave simulations, and the results demonstrate that they match well with each other, validating the advantage of employing metasurface design to sensor for wide-range material sensing.

articleTitle: Thirteen Level Inverter with Low Switch Count and Self Balancing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: An essential part of the process of transferring energy from renewable sources to electrical applications is the multilayer inverter (MLI). Switches can be eliminated by using switched capacitor-based dc-ac multilevel converters. A six-switch full bridge with a low frequency half bridge is used to execute the switched capacitor-based inverter, stepping up the output voltage. The voltage stress and power loss are kept as low as feasible during design. Self-balancing capacitors, which do not require an auxiliary circuit, are used in the thirteen level MLI design. However, big capacitances are used to lower the peak charging current and voltage ripple. Without using any switches or diodes, this topology achieves maximum voltage gain with a low switch count. The viability and transient performance of basic frequency modulation are verified by this K Type 13-level MLI. The simulation of this geometry has produced accurate results.

articleTitle: Piezoelectric Based Power Generation For Portable Charging System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Thi<sup>s</sup> paper highlights the idea of generating power using footsteps. It is based on the piezoelectric effect of material being used for production of energy. Energy has been needed and used by man at an increasing rate since time immemorial. An idea for using and putting to use an extravagant amount of energy in human feet is very much in line with the goals of tremendously populated countries like China and India. For developing nations where there is a high need for electricity, a proposal for the use of foot power waste energy with human mobility is pertinent. The use of piezoelectric materials to generate and store energy from vibrations caused by people walking and other types of vibrations is described in this study. The “footstep power generating system's operating concept is based on piezoelectric sensors. When the flooring is constructed using piezoelectric technology, floor sensors catch the electrical energy generated by the pressure and a transducer transforms it into an electrical charge. These sensors are being placed in places or areas where there is huge crowd movement, like on footpaths, treadmills, city malls, shopping complexes, and more, in places with proper safety and equipment like breakers or shock absorbers. At these places, a huge amount of energy is wasted as mechanical or heat energy, which can be very useful.

articleTitle: Government Infra Assessment System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Without involving any other parties and abstaining from any other compromised operations across India, Government Infra Assessment System would provide all the necessary information regarding Government Infrastructure to the Government itself. Government employees will not only benefit from time savings, but also from the ability to view the database whenever they want without waiting.

articleTitle: A TKF Based Adaptive Filtering for ECG Signal
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Most of the time, various kinds of noises corrupt an ECG signal. A portion of these commotions are power line interface, benchmark float, muscle withdrawal, movement relics, electrosurgical noise, instrumentation commotion and electromyography noises. A method capable of significantly filtering ECG signal noises must be developed urgently. An EMD, a three-iteration Kalman adaptive filter (TKF), and a brand-new Customized Otsu Thresholding (COT)-based method for de-noising the ECG signal are all presented in this work. This work is capable of denoising lower and higher order IMFs (Intrinsic mode functions) in place of old EMD-based de-noising methods, which only denoise IMFs of lower orders. In addition to EMD and TKF operation, this work has been utilized to further enhance signal quality. After taking into consideration the first iteration, the efficiency of the TKF measure, and applying two additional adaptive iterations of the Kalman filter to further improve the signal quality on the standard MIT-BIH arrhythmia database, the described technique's validity is evaluated. In order to validate the proposed method in a noisy real-time environment, Gaussian noise of various SNR levels is added to the initial signals.

articleTitle: FIS Based Fault Identification and Classification in IEEE RTS96 System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper proposes fuzzy inference system (FIS) to identify and classify power transmission line faults. Testing of the suggested fuzzy logic-based protection strategy has been conducted for a variety of fault scenarios and fault parameter ranges. When a fault arises in the power system, current waveforms are altered by fault conditions, and the magnitude varies based on the type of fault. The measured instantaneous current and zero-sequence current signals are processed for identification of fault. The findings demonstrate that the proposed method is effective at determining and grouping the class of fault in an IEEE RTS96 system. The analysis has determined the effectiveness of the suggested system for identifying line faults.

articleTitle: Smart Attendance System Using Biometric and GPS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Any academic institution must maintain an attendance system to teach discipline to students. It is also a factor to evaluate student performance in regularity. The repetition of taking attendance makes it time-consuming. Since the administration was following the traditional way of attendance taking costs more labour and time. To mark attendance, students must scan a QR code containing the student details provided by the institute. With the obj ective of preventing cheating, the system uses biometric identification, primarily fingerprints unique to each individual. After these complete processes, the software marks the student's attendance based on time and their presence in the class. The GPS Technology allows us to check if students gave their attendance within the classes by using the latitude and longitude coordinates of the corner of students' classes. The smart attendance system allows staff to download a copy of student attendance as an Excel file and make a final report of the attendance of all students. Finally, the system achieves these expectations is cost-efficient and speeds up the process.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Emitter and Collector Coupling for Synchronization of Chaotic Colpitts Oscillators
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this work, we present a detailed disquisition of the effect of emitter coupling, collector coupling, and different values of coupling measure on the synchronization of a motorist response configuration system(unidirectional coupling between two identical systems) by a direct difference system. This exploration work focuses on the performance of chaotic Colpitts oscillators which are emitter coupled and collector coupled by numerical disquisition of settling time of synchronization by direct difference signal system in MATLAB. Synchronization Characteristics of Collector Coupled Colpitts Oscillator and an emitter coupled Colpitts oscillator has been tabulated and colluded against coupling measure. Results of examinations have been colluded as the plot of RMS of Error and Standard divagation of Error and settling time versus breadth for the maximum positive divagation and maximum negative divagation. This shows that the emitter-coupled system has an important smoother error wind with respect to coupling measure and emitter-coupled systems have lower positive divagation while Collector coupled systems have lower negative divagation. These plots also show that Colpitts oscillators are settled down beforehand in emitter coupling which is0.4 and after at 0.6 collectors coupled oscillators are settled down.

articleTitle: Machine learning based approach to predict cardiovascular diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease has now established itself as a major threat to human health, with an increasing number of patients suffering from it. The disparity between a dearth of medical resources and an increase in the number of patients has become increasingly apparent in this environment. The ability to forecast cardiovascular illness has become increasingly crucial. We are working on Cardiovascular disease prediction on the basis of the data set involving common parameters like age, gender, weight, Cholesterol, smoke, glucose, alcohol etc with help of Logistic Regression by which we achieved nearly 73 % accuracy and CNN model by which we achieved 74.6 % accuracy.

articleTitle: IoT and Machine Learning based Standalone Health Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Tele-health is now playing a bigger part in worldwide health-care delivery. Since the epidemic hit this globe, the use of health-care surveil systems has increased dramatically. The motive of this article is to produce a prototype of a standalone health surveil system that can be placed at a case's home to replace conventional corporal checks at the sanitarium by using a BH1790GLC heart rate module and SPO2 detector to decide introductory health parameters from the case, similar as heart rate and oxygen achromatism. The heart rate and SpO2 situations are covered in real- time and displayed on the web app. This proposed system is compared to request-available movable detectors. The whole system will be powered by a PV module to make it a standalone system. The heart rate and SpO2 data is used to prognosticate if the case is suffering from complaint or can have complaint in future.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Deep Learning Methods and Face Detection Framework with Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In the current technological evaluations artificial intelligence frameworks are increasing every day. Face detection has become one of the interesting areas of research where accurate face detection is required. The most commonly used face detection framework is Viola Jones algorithm using Haar feature cascade algorithm. Feature extraction is important to accurately detect the face. In order to rectify complications in feature extraction process a convolutional neural network CNN based novel robust framework is developed here. The Model considers the face images and performs three different face feature extraction method comparatively. Feature extraction using hog classifier, Face detection using Haar cascade and convolutional neural network (CNN) based feature extraction process are comparatively analyzed here. The proposed model is compared with various state of art approaches in terms of accuracy, and statistical parameters such as False rejection rate, false acceptance rate and error rate. Real time face detection has significant challenges over static face detection frameworks. The face detection models with frontal face, unique attribute detection are deeply correlated with deep convolutional neural network in the proposed model.

articleTitle: A Novel Optical Encryption Strategy using Virtual Digital Holography and Fractional Fourier Based Key Hiding
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This communication presents a novel image encryption strategy using on virtual optics, digital holography, phase shifting, and fractional Fourier transform (FRT) based key hiding. The sensitive information needed to be transferred was converted as a binary image and encrypted using Mach-Zehnder virtual holography. For recovering the phase information from the deformed hologram, decryption was performed. Towards this, four step wrapped phase recovery, and line scan based unwrapping strategy was used. For secure key transmission, FRT with two random phase masks along with tuning parameters were used. The results retrieved using simulation conclusively establish the validity of the proposed strategy and security against hack attacks. For analyzing the information accuracy of the strategy, root mean square error was calculated.

articleTitle: REVIEW OF BIG DATA ANALYTICS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In today's technological era, the decision-making that takes place has a very high amount of data to be worked upon. Big data is so vast and has such a wide variety involved to it that it gets very difficult to manage it according to how it was done before. Due to this reason and a constant change in data, we need to find solutions for the same. People involved in big data analytics can find conclusions from the data itself. The data might be from social networks, everyday transactions, consumer contacts, and many more. Hence advanced analytics techniques on the data provide us with a lot of different advantages. This study aims to find and look at various analytical techniques, mechanisms, benefits, problems, and tools that can be used in this field. It also briefs us with the opportunities that are offered by the same for decision makers involved in the same.

articleTitle: Automatic Classification of Multi-Class Skin Lesions Dermoscopy Images Using an Efficient Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Skin cancer has a high death rate that regularly impacts individual lives globally. Early diagnosis of it expands individual survival and aids in the prevention of disease. Manual assessment of skin lesions requires more time for assessment. In this work, a lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN) is developed for the automated classification of multi-class skin lesions utilizing dermoscopy images. Images from dermoscopy are denoised utilizing median filter. The resulting denoised dermoscopy images are given as input to proposed network, ResNet50, and VGG16. The proposed network attained classi-fying accuracy of 89.71 %. Compared to ResNet50 and VGG16 developed CNN is light as it needs lower learnable parameters. The outcome of the presented network is compared with other existing methodologies.

articleTitle: Music Genre Classification Based on Song Titles with Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This study used deep learning models to classify songs into eight genres based on their titles. The task was challenging because many titles only have three or four words, which may not clearly indicate the genre. The study used a dataset of 50,000 songs and their attributes from Kaggle, and the titles were pre-processed to be compatible with the models. The study compared different deep learning models and found that the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) with an extra layer and a dropout was the most accurate, with an accuracy of 42.21%. To the best of the authors' knowledge, there have been no previous studies on music genre classification using song titles, making this study unique in its field.

articleTitle: A Planar Dual-Band 4-Element MIMO Configuration for WLAN and Sub-6 GHz 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A novel dual-band 4-port MIMO configuration is introduced in this research work for the WLAN (2.4 GHz band) and 5G (3.5 GHz band of Sub-6 GHz) wireless applications. It provides good -10 dB return loss bandwidth of 8.3% (2.3 - 2.5 GHz) and 9.92% (3.35 - 3.7 GHz) in the <tex>$\mathbf{1}^{\mathbf{st}}$</tex> and <tex>$\mathbf{2}^{\mathbf{nd}}$</tex> operating bands, respectively. It is implemented on an inexpensive FR-4 substrate of dimensions <tex>$\mathbf{60} \times \mathbf{60}\ \mathbf{mm}^{\mathbf{2}}$</tex>. The dual-band planar monopole MIMO antenna element comprises i) a Curve-shaped monopole and ii) an open-ended inverted L-shaped slot. The curvature of the monopole antenna element miniaturizes the design footprint by 33.33% compared to the conventional rectangular monopole antenna. It is realized with a form factor of 0.15 <tex>$\boldsymbol{\lambda}_{\mathbf{0}}\ \times \mathbf{0}.\mathbf{23}\boldsymbol{\lambda}_{\mathbf{0}}$</tex>. The elements are oriented perpendicular to each other to implement the 4-port MIMO configuration. The orthogonal arrangement provides polarization diversity that suppresses the mutual coupling between the elements below 17.5 dB. The MIMO design has omnidirectional radiation characteristics with reasonably good peak gains (2.14 and 2.48 dBi) and radiation efficiencies (84 and 91%) in the WLAN and 5G operating bands. The computed ECC is below 0.045, and TARC is less than -10 dB across both bands. The excellent diversity characteristics of the presented MIMO configuration make it well-suitable for the targeted MIMO applications.

articleTitle: Optical Performance Enhancement of GaAsBi/P3HT Hybrid Solar CellIncorporatingMetallic Nanoparticlesinthe Absorber Layer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: GaA<inf>s1-x</inf>Bi<inf>x</inf> alloy semiconductors have been an attractive material for optoelectronic applications due to its bandgap tailoring property with variable mole fraction “x”. The optical properties of thin film GaAs0.99Bi<inf>0.01</inf> solar cell with a thin donor shell of P3HT and ITO on the top have been investigated. In order to boost the optical absorption, photo-generation rate in thin film HSC, plasmonic metal nanoparticles are incorporated in the donor shell. A 400nm thick layer of thin film absorbing material GaAs0.99Bi<inf>0.01</inf>, 100nm thick hole transport layer of P3HT and 100nm thick ITO layer as a top electrode, 100nm thick Al bottom electrode have been chosen for this simulation study. A comparative study of the optical properties of plasmonic MNP based HSC thin film solar cell is carried out with an array of three different materials of nanoparticles such as gold(Au), silver(Ag) and Aluminium (Al). A thorough geometry optimization study is done based on the diameter of MPNs as well as Filling Ratio (FR) of the unit cell. Photo generation rate profile upon illumination by incident solar spectrum, electric field profile at different wavelengths for different MNPs are studied and presented in this paper. The 400nm thick absorber layer produces a J<inf>sc</inf> of 31.8969 mA/cm<sup>2</sup> without the plasmonic effect whereas it produces Jsc values of 34.1957 mA/cm<sup>2</sup>, 32.0325 mA/cm<sup>2</sup> and 33.5517 mA/cm<sup>2</sup> for Au, Ag and Al MNP respectively with a FR of 0.5 of unit solar cell.

articleTitle: Covid Wave Prediction using SARIMA Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A speedy and accurate diagnosis of COVID-19 is made possible by effective SARS-Co V -2 screening, which can also lessen the strain on health care systems. There have been built prediction models that assess the likelihood of infection by combining a number of parameters. These are intended to help medical professionals worldwide prioritize patients, particularly when there are few healthcare resources available. From a dataset of 51,831 tested people, out of which 4,769 were confirmed to have COVID-19 virus, a machine learning method was developed and trained. Records of the following week with 47,401 tested people, of which 3,624 were tested positive was also considered. Our method accurately predicted the COVID-19 test results using eight binary characteristics, including gender, age 60, known contact with an infected person, and the presence of five early clinical signs.

articleTitle: Generalized Immutable Ledger (GILED) using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Applications of centralised databases have been found in many areas. Almost every organization, private or public, makes use of centralised databases. These databases hold the entire scenario about the organization, like records of their customers, transactions occurring in the organization, past analysis, current performance, future prediction, and a lot more things that can be calculated over them. Basically, these databases are the roots of a particular organization. But the issue regarding these centralised databases is that their access is totally open to some individuals or a particular group of people within the organization. The issue that has been identified is corruption. It is difficult for an outsider to manipulate the data, but it is very simple for anyone within the organisation to do so. Now here the owner of the organization, whether an individual or the government, and the customers of the organisation face trouble because these manipulations are done in such a fine manner that only the person manipulating them knows the changes, while the owner and the customer are unaware of them. These things are more likely to be seen in government sectors. So in order to overcome the existing problem, we are considering using block chain technology in our project. Since the block chain is a distributed network, manipulation of the data is impossible by a single corrupt person. Each minute change made in a ledger can be tracked using a block chain. Many applications have already been deployed to address this issue, but this paper is about generalization, which will be based on a multi-purpose use case rather than a specific use case. This paper gives a generalised solution to solve the above-mentioned problem in any field or use case.

articleTitle: Using The Cooja Simulator, Analysing The Routing Protocol (RPL) For Low Power And Lossy Networks In IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: RPL IoT Projects is the newest bloom field that permits packet flow between nodes. The RPL is an extension of the Protocol for Routing in Lossy and Low Power Networks. It is an IPv6 protocol built on graphs. The Internet of Things (IoT) is one of the most flexible sectors. In this research Paper, we examined the real operation of RPL using a Cooja Simulator.

articleTitle: An efficient LGBM based DDoS attack Detection Approach for SD-IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Internet of Things(IoT) applications have grown more prevalent, making security a top priority. Many IoT devices participated to a recent distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack without their owners' knowledge. To control IoT devices securely, the new SDx paradigm is evolving. This study begin by outlining a high-level architecture for the SD-IoT, which is based on the SDx paradigm. The objective of this work is to efficiently detect the DDoS attack in the controller of the SD-IoT. For this, a dataset created in the control plane of SDN has been used for training some well-known classifiers namely LGBM, SVM, Random Forest, and KNN, with the objective to find the best performing classifier under some performance measuring metrics namely; accuracy, F1, recall, precision, Cohen's Kappa Coefficient, False Alarm Rate(FAR) and execution time. It is found that LGBM is outperforming all the classifiers as it is giving values more than 99.72% values for accuracy, precision, recall, and F1, and 0.35% for FAR, 4.134 second for execution time, and 99.42 for CKC. Finally, the performance of this best performing classifier i.e., LGBM is compared with some similar state-of-the-art works. It is found that again it is outperforming other works.

Index Terms: Distributed Denial Of Service Attack Detection

articleTitle: A Focusing Meta-surface with High Transmittance and Low Profile for Millimeter-wave Lens Antennas
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A focusing meta-surface lens using layered phase compensation is proposed. The meta-surface is designed to converge the propagating plane waves to the focal point with high transmittance in a compact size of <tex>$\mathbf{103}.\mathbf{5}\ \mathbf{mm}\times \mathbf{103}.\mathbf{5}\ \mathbf{mm} \times \mathbf{1}.\mathbf{524}\ \mathbf{mm}$</tex>. A horn operating at 24 GHz is placed at the focal point of the meta-surface as the source for generating mmWaves, which propagate through the meta-surface to form plane waves with well-defined radiation patterns. Compared with a single horn antenna with gain 10.9 dBi, the lens antenna can obtain enhanced gain as high as 25.9 dBi, meanwhile the - 17.6 dB sidelobe is low as well. The proposed focusing meta-surface lens with low profile, high gain, low sidelobe provides a good option for millimeter-wave communications.

articleTitle: A System for Medical Record Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: By the mean of these paper brief description, we describe briefly the concept of system for medical record using blockchain system. Blockchain is a popular technology with a decentralized focus on security. So By the mean of these paper brief description, we express the concept of system for medical record management using blockchain. Instead a blockchain is a trending technology that we focus on security which is decentralized. So that is it does not have only one admin to handle medical records. Instead of that the recent system focusing on enhancement and advancement of system we work on concept of blockchain cryptography in that we pass simple query and convert it in complex query by using encoding and decoding mechanism. By viewing the influence of blockchain cryptography which is decentralized in nature which consist of more than one admin and focusing on security. It store large amount of patients data and retrieve easily and the blockchain allow user to make to secure authentic data by generating key which is private. As they are not vulnerable to a single point of neglect, these two properties of blockchain can be coupled together to build a data management system that is totally cyberpunk testimonial. Data security can be improved by using the concept of cryptography, which is one of the important benefit of blockchain that it provides higher security. Healthcare information is some of the most secretive and concealed data that is significant even under the strongest prohibition. This data can be shielded from manipulation and unwanted access thanks to the concept of blockchain technology.

articleTitle: Driver Drowsiness Detection and Alerting Model for Minimizing Road Accidents
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The Drowsiness comes between the state of staying awake and sleeping. Drowsiness might not be a problem in some scenarios, but when it comes to driving it is a life-taking problem and drivers need some kind of alerting system, to get out of the problems. Alerting systems would help the driver reach his normal state. In the previous work, the tactic used was Encephalogram wherever electrodes area unit placed on the driver's scalp and these electrodes facilitate the system to watch the brain's electrical signals that flow through the neurons of the brain. This method becomes a bit complicated since any driver must be comfortable while driving but wearing those electrodes not only makes the driver uncomfortable but also makes the whole system complicated. These problems can be overcome by considering an eye monitoring software that is incorporated into a piece of hardware that further can be put inside the car. When the software detects the conditions of the driver's eyes, then the hardware incorporated in the car would alert the driver.

articleTitle: Reconfiguration of the Distribution Network using a Whale Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The most prevalent and crucial approach to energy system reconfiguration can be used to enhance the power system for distribution, which is covered in this paper. Reconfiguration entails modifying the status of switches in the network's radial distribution topology. The aim is to enhance the power profile while lowering the complete loss of power. This problem was solved using a variety of optimization strategies, including heuristic methods, which are more effective in this case, and classical optimization, which is a time-consuming methodology. To find the best case in the reconfiguration problem, the whale optimization algorithm (WOA), a modern heuristic optimization approach, is used. When solving discrete optimization issues, the WOA is quite effective. The outcomes of WOA are contrasted with those of several heuristic methods (33 bus systems and 69 bus systems).

articleTitle: Reduction in Harmonics at load Side of Dynamic Voltage Restorer at Different Dip Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Due to harmonic distortion, voltage dips, voltage swells, and frequency variations, power quality is the most crucial problem in the distribution system. A device which is connected in series known as Dynamic voltage Restorer is smaller in size, has a higher energy storage capacity, and is more power-efficient than other specialized power devices, is used in this paper to compensate for voltage dips. In this study, the voltage drop at various dipped values is balanced using space vector pulse width modulation approach. Employing Fast Fourier Transform analysis, the Total harmonic Distortion values are also computed and analyzed for two different conditions that is having filter unit and absence of filter respectively is utilized in the DVR section. The analysis shows the improvement in the Total harmonic Distortion by incorporating the filter section is also assessed.

articleTitle: Design A Voice App Controlled IoT Based Water Tank System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: An IoT-based water tank system controlled by a voice app is a system that allows users to remotely monitor and control the water level in a tank using a voice-enabled device, such as a smartphone or smart speaker. The system consists of hardware components, including sensors to measure the water level, a valve or pump to control the flow of water, and a microcontroller or single-board computer to act as the brain of the system. The system also includes a communication module to connect it to the internet and a cloud platform to host the IoT application and manage the data from the system. The voice app allows users to check the current water level, fill or drain the tank, and set alerts for when the water level reaches a certain threshold. The system can be used for a variety of purposes, such as irrigation, household use, or industrial processes. By enabling remote monitoring and control of the water tank, the system can improve efficiency and reduce the risk of water shortages or excesses.

articleTitle: Random Key Generation based Double Image Encryption System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Encryption technique is widely used to ensure security in communication and wireless networks such as the Internet, Networking zone and Intranet. Every type of data has its own characteristics consequently, to safeguard private picture data from unwanted access, a variety of strategies are employed. In this paper an image encryption technology called Data Encryption Standard (DES) is combined with XOR to create a block cypher transformation algorithm for picture security. The suggested method is based on XOR with DES encryption, which emphasizes larger changes in the RGB combination as well as the histogram. The findings of the suggested method indicate more variety. The security of the system will be increased by increasing the variety.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation Of Energy Selective Surface
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: With the development of information technology, electronic equipment continues to develop towards intelligence and miniaturization, but the threat of strong electromagnetic pulses is becoming more and more serious. Therefore, this paper studies the cross-shaped energy selective surface. Based on it, an energy selective surface based on the Jerusalem cross is designed and simulated. The simulation results show that in the C-band, the designed Jerusalem cross-shaped energy selective surface can realize small signal transmission and has the function of self-adaptive limiting protection against strong electromagnetic pulses.

articleTitle: Analysis of Linux Server Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This report presents an analysis of how performance tuning on Enterprise Linux impacts the performance of different server programs. While researchers historically measure performance based on one or more of the following parameters: memory, I/O, networking or CPU, these are just some of the server programs that should be considered when performance are analysed. Naturally, these four parameters are influenced differently by the impact of tuning and tuning which, in turn, sets the acoustics curve of each one of the server programs being measured.

articleTitle: Modelling Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell for Power Generation Using Multi-Stage Power Conversion System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Fuel cell (FC) systems are now being used as an alternative to conventional sources due to their capability of supplying electricity in far-flung or remote areas as well as contributing to Distributed Generation (DG) systems while supplying at peak loads and portability. This paper deals with modelling a Proton Exchange Membrane FC system in MATLAB Simulink for power generation which is further supplied to the load using multi-stage owner conversion for a single-phase system. The system uses stacked FC, DC-DC Converter, load and DC-AC inverter. A PID controller is applied to control the output of DC-DC converter. The battery is combined with a fuel cell to store the excess amount of energy as the load is not always the same and revert the power back to the load using a bidirectional converter. The load used in the system is a series RLC load. The voltage obtained at the output of the load is 79 volts.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of the Occlusion Identification Based Gait Recognition Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This pattern module of gait has been developed by the capturing process of a scene of obj ects during the walking cycle of subjects, but in the case of a populated or multi-person environment, the region of interest or subject is often obstructed by the numerous static and dynamic obj ects. Due to the obstruction (process of occlusion), the information developed by the gait pattern model has been discarded or lost. This process of obstruction of the subject due to several environmental objects during the development of the gait pattern is known as occlusion. Numerous techniques, including Lagrange's inter-polation, piece-wise cubic hermite interpolation, spline inter-polation, periodic curve fitting, linear curve fitting, and quadratic curve fitting, were applied in the reconstruction of these hidden sequences of the pattern gait module. This work provides an introduction to the mechanisms involved in occluded-based gait reconstruction and explores the difficulties encountered in trying to describe this system. This paper also describes the literature reported by numerous researchers over the past few years. The primary goal of this paper is to provide a comprehensive review of the current methods for recovering occluded gait patterns based on research.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Low Power FINFET SRAM Cells on Different Technology Node with Variable Number of Transistors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: CMOS devices has played the huge role in the evolution of technology over the time. As time passes scaling of device reaches to the level where it has several problems because the gate is not able to control the concentration of charge carrier in channel further. Even though SRAMs are designed using standard CMOS the issue of power dissipation and high-power leaks increases with the scaling, which greatly undermines its effectiveness. Memory should have faster, lower access time, low power dissipation and low leakage. Here comes the FINFET technology which is used to design SRAM in addition to CMOS technology. Here, this paper represents a comparative analysis between 6T, 7T, 8T, 9T, and 10T SRAM. As we are aware that Leakage of SRAM cells proportionally affects stability. So, it is required to minimize the leakage using different approach. This paper consists of SRAM analysis using different no. of transistor with FinFET technology on different nodes. The different designs and methods for comparative analysis of SRAM is done.

articleTitle: Gait Assessment using Optimized Machine Learning and Feature Selection Algorithm for identifies Parkinson's Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This study develops efficient Machine Learning models to diagnose Parkinson's disease (PD) patients through gait sensor signals. Slow-moving tremors and inflexible limbs characterize Parkinson's disease (PD), and altered gaits, such as hunched posture, shuffled steps, festination, freezing of gait, and falls. This work aimed to develop machine learning models to recognize PD patients from the subjects' walking motion data. The prediction model proposed using ML Algorithms with hyperparameter optimization using GridSearch. In this study, we compare two experiments to analyze the result without feature selection; the other uses the top 91 features through the RFE algorithm. The ensemble voting classifier using RFE feature selection had the highest Accuracy achieved at 96.1%. The proposed strategy has achieved the highest classification accuracy compared to previously employed methodologies from earlier research.

articleTitle: Analysis and Methodology to Reduce Aggregate Technical & Commercial Losses
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Affordable power in a sustainable way is the need of the time. To achieve this several new methodology are being experimented to minimize the Aggregate Technical & Commercial Losses (AT &C) losses in power distribution system. Here we have highlighted the factors responsible for the technical and commercial losses in a power distribution system and will study the techniques to mitigate the loss and dissection of AT &C losses at distribution company (DISCOM) level for South Bihar Power Distribution Company Limited (SBPDCL). This work will assist in improving the efficiency and revenue of the power distribution system at DISCOM level.

articleTitle: Review on BIST architectures of DRAMs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: As the technology continues to grow, different kinds of DRAMs and their testing architectures are being developed. This paper focuses on the comparison of various BIST architectures of DRAM in the recent times. In this paper, an In-DRAM built-in self-test (BIST) mechanism for the bit cell failures caused by external environment is compared with itself using two different test algorithms for better performance. It is also compared high bandwidth memory (HBM) BIST, HBM 2 Extension (HBM2E) BIST and channel-sharable BIST architecture for the demand of high bandwidth. The different characteristics of the DRAM BISTs' such as area overhead, test time reduction, test patterns, modes, operating voltages, temperatures and faults detected using these BISTS have been compared in this paper as follows.

articleTitle: Smart IR Drop Reduction technique using Pegasus flow
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: With advancement in technology, the challenges in terms of power, area, and timing have increased exponentially. Shrinking technology results in more cells in smaller area causing significant increase in terms of peak current requirement. Also, IR Drop hotspots occur due to high current requirements in particular regions. Hence, it becomes very important to reduce the IR Drop as it impacts the speed of the cells as well as the overall performance of the chip. In this paper, we have proposed a Post-PNR Addition of smart power and ground Metal Fills, without impacting on the timing of a device to improve IR drop.

articleTitle: Modified Ultra-Low Power Electronically Tunable Current Mode Instrumentation Amplifier For Biomedical Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this paper, a proposed modified current mode instrumentation amplifier (CMIA) circuit has been designed, which can be used in low-power applications such as in biomedical domain. The instrumentation amplifier is in current mode, the circuit enjoys the advantage of electronic tunability. There is no need of a variable resistor to change the instrumentation amplifier gain, the gain can be changed electronically i.e. by changing either bias currents or bias voltages. All the simulations have been performed in cadence virtuoso at UMC-180nm technology. The proposed modified CMIA provides a differential gain in the range (29.97dB - 43dB), CMRR in the range (69.71dB - 71.05dB), power dissipation in the range (300.67nW - 371.16nW). The proposed modified CMIA also provides an improvement in CMRR of 52 with respect to CC-CMIA [4] and an improvement of 23.24 As an application example, this CMIA can be used in pacemakers, as it is capable enough to amplify ECG signals, and also to remove any power line interference noise or motion artifacts that affects the ECG signal. Also because of its low voltage-supply requirement and low power dissipation, it can find its application in low power devices.

articleTitle: Hybrid and Classical Models of Recommendation Systems- A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Recommendation Systems (RS) have evolved as a response to information overload caused by the growth in online content, increasing users' search time and information retrieval rate. By providing consumers with personalized suggestions based on their past preferences, likes, and dislikes, RS is used to find relevant content. Products, videos, photos, articles, news, and books are a few of the areas where these technologies are applied. Both attribute data, such as textual profiles and significant keywords, and user-item interactions such as ratings or purchasing activity are used by RS to analyze. This article provides an outline of the needs and difficulties of RS. To achieve greater recommendation capabilities in a variety of situations, this study attempts to explain the limits of the current generation of recommendation approaches and potential expansions with recommender systems. The results of the proposed methods have good improvement when compared with existing techniques.

articleTitle: Decoupled Control of Rotor Side Power Electronic Converter for Grid Connected DFIG Based Wind Energy System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Wind and solar power mechanisms are the most admired and favoured owing to the availability of their sources, and as a result, there has been a significant amount of work done on renewable power technologies in preparation for the forthcoming trend. The wind power conversion system and control technique applications on the generator for continuous power generation are the focus of this article. This article addresses a varying speed fixed frequency doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) system for a wind-power system employing a back-to-back converter. In today's huge wind power systems, the DFIG is a variable-speed induction machinery that is widely utilised as a generator. It is a traditional woundrotor induction machinery with the windings of its stator are linked to the grid directly. And the rotor winding reaches the power grid through the AC-DC-AC PWM-converter. The AC-DC-AC converter typically normally composed of two separate power electronic converters, one for the rotor called rotor-side power electronic converter and one for the grid called grid side power electronic converter. In this paper, rotor-side power electronic converter are controlled by a decoupled vector control scheme. To demonstrate the efficacy of the presented control scheme, the examined system is simulated for a step variation in the input torque of the DFIG using Sim Power System Simulink in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Two-Stage Micro-Inverter under Different Pulse Modulation Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The high power capability of multilevel inverters in medium and low voltage applications is making them increasingly popular nowadays. The analysis of a five level T-type inverter connected with solar photovoltaic is presented in this paper. This paper focuses on the analysis and study of different modulating techniques on aT-type inverter. The Level-shifting Pulse Width Modulation (LSPWM) and Phase Shifting Pulse Width Modulation (PSPWM) are compared in this work. LSPWM techniques include Phase Disposition Pulse Width Modulation (PDPWM), Phase Opposition Disposition Pulse Width Modulation (PODPWM), Alternate Phase Opposition Disposition Pulse Width Modulation (APODPWM). A comparison of the results is made based on the total harmonic distortion (THD). The analysis is performed on PSIM environment and it is found that for T -type multi-level inverter, level-shifted PWM techniques are a better choice as compared to phase-shifted PWM technique.

articleTitle: Hand Sign Language Detection - Using Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Nearly 466 Million people on our Earth are Dumb and Deaf. These people are unable to hear or speak. Communication is a Major Aspectfor each and every Human being. It becomes difficult for these Inarticulate people to communicate with all people. These people have their own method to communicate which is by doing Hand gestures and making certain symbols with their hands. Our model will detect these Gestures and Predict what those gestures mean and what are they trying to communicate. With the help of a Deep Neural Network, the Model is trained and they are capable of detecting the Signs. For Binary Classification we have used logistic Regression, a 2-layer Neural network as in ANN(Artificial neural network).

articleTitle: Data Hide Security Using Image Object
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
